definition_zh: 班级；课；阶级；类别；等级
definition_en: a group of students taught together, a lesson, a social rank, or a group of things of the same type
core_image: 一间教室里按排坐好的学生，黑板写着课表
scene: 铃声响过，走廊一下空了，只有一间教室还亮着灯。She stayed behind after class to ask a question.
sceneCN: 这里 class 指「课」（第 1 个义项：按班级进行的一节课）；句意是下课后她留下来问了一个问题。

senses.title: A group of students or a lesson
senses.definition: a group of students taught together, or a period of teaching
senses.definitionCN: 一起上课的一群学生，或一节课
senses.example: Our class has thirty students this year.
senses.exampleCN: 我们班今年有三十名学生。
senses.why: The Latin word for a division of people was applied to the division of pupils in a school.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语里表示人群划分的词，被用来指学校里学生的划分。

senses.title: A social rank
senses.definition: a group of people with a similar position in society
senses.definitionCN: 在社会中地位相近的一群人
senses.example: The novel follows a family across three social classes.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说写一个家庭横跨三个社会阶层。
senses.why: Roman citizens were officially divided into ranks, and the word kept that meaning of a ranked group.
senses.whyCN: 罗马公民被正式分为不同等级，这个词保留了按等级分组的含义。

senses.title: A category of things
senses.definition: a group of things or people that share the same type or quality
senses.definitionCN: 属于同一类型或同一品质的一组事物或人
senses.example: This ticket is for a different class of seat.
senses.exampleCN: 这张票对应的是另一种等级的座位。
senses.why: Any division into groups can be called a class, so the word moved from people to objects.
senses.whyCN: 任何分组都可以叫 class，于是这个词从人扩展到了物。

intro.en: Class comes from the Latin name for a division of Roman citizens by property.
intro.cn: class 出自拉丁语，本指按财产对罗马公民所作的划分。

items.en: Classis divided Roman citizens into ranked groups.
items.cn: classis 把罗马公民按等级分组。

items.en: The word also named a fleet, that is, a group of ships.
items.cn: 这个词也指舰队，即一组船只。

items.en: Classe meant a group or an order of things.
items.cn: classe 指一群或一等级的事物。

items.en: English used class for school groups and for ranks of society.
items.cn: 英语用 class 指学校的班级与社会等级。

items.en: The word now covers any category, from hotel rooms to animals.
items.cn: 这个词如今涵盖任何类别，从酒店房型到动物分类。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words with a similar short shape, while the meaning group names kinds and levels.
note.cn: 形近组列出外形相近的短词，近义组列出种类与层级。

entries.definition: a part of a sentence with its own verb

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the school sense, the social sense and the sorting sense.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用学校义、社会阶层义与归类义。

normal.en: One word covers a school group, a social rank and a set of objects, because all three are divisions.
normal.cn: 一个词兼指学校班级、社会等级与一类物品，因为三者都是划分。

normal.en: After class and in class are fixed phrases with no article.
normal.cn: after class 与 in class 是固定说法，都不加冠词。

normal.en: The working class is a group of people, while first class is a level of service.
normal.cn: the working class 指一群人，first class 指一种服务等级。

normal.en: The plural classes adds a syllable, so it ends in a clear hiss.
normal.cn: 复数 classes 多一个音节，结尾有一声清晰的嘶音。

normal.en: Class is the noun, classify is the verb, and classification is the result.
normal.cn: class 是名词，classify 是动词，classification 是结果。

abstract.cn: 想象一座剧院，廉价座位在高处，包厢在下面。

abstract.en: Picture a drawer of screws sorted into small labelled boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象一抽屉螺钉被分进贴了标签的小盒里。

sensesIntro.en: A division of citizens becomes a school group, then a social rank, then any category.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of pupils seated in a room under a timetable.
core.cn: 核心意象：教室里一排排坐好的学生，上方挂着课表。

branches.en: The ranked group becomes a group of pupils.
branches.cn: 按等级划分的群体变成了一个班的学生。

branches.en: Rank in society keeps the old Roman sense.
branches.cn: 社会等级保留了古罗马的含义。

branches.en: Any set of similar things can be one class.
branches.cn: 任何同类事物的集合都可以是一个类别。

branches.en: A school class is only one case of a general category.
branches.cn: 学校班级只是一般类别中的一个实例。

branches.en: Rank and kind both depend on sorting by a standard.
branches.cn: 等级与种类都依赖按某种标准分类。

intro.en: The noun takes a plural and a verb ending, and feeds a family of classifying words.
intro.cn: 这个名词接复数与动词词尾，并衍生出一组分类相关词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin classis, a division, which also gave classical and classify.

latinEntries.example: Classis is the base of class and classify.
latinEntries.exampleCN: classis 是 class 与 classify 的词基。

definition_zh: 经典的；一流的；典型的；经典作品；名著
definition_en: of lasting high quality and widely admired, very typical of its kind, or a work of this quality
core_image: 书架上被翻旧的名著，封面已经褪色
scene: 书架最上层那本旧书已经被翻得起了毛边。His first novel is now a classic of modern fiction.
sceneCN: 这里 classic 指「经典作品」（第 2 个义项：经久不衰、广受推崇的作品）；句意是他的第一部小说如今已是现代小说的经典。

senses.title: Of lasting high quality
senses.definition: admired for a long time and regarded as a standard of good quality
senses.definitionCN: 长期受到推崇并被当作优秀标准的
senses.example: This is a classic study of city life.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一项关于城市生活的经典研究。
senses.why: Roman writers of the highest rank were called classic, so the best works took the label.
senses.whyCN: 最高等级的罗马作家被称为 classic，于是最好的作品也得了这个标签。

senses.title: A work of lasting value
senses.definition: a book, film or piece of music that remains admired over time
senses.definitionCN: 长期受到推崇的书、电影或乐曲
senses.example: The film became a classic within a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片十年内就成了经典。
senses.why: The adjective turned into a noun and named the work itself, not just its quality.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转成名词，用来指作品本身，而不只是它的品质。

senses.title: Very typical of its kind
senses.definition: showing all the usual features of a type, often of a bad kind
senses.definitionCN: 具有某类事物全部常见特征的，常指不好的典型
senses.example: Forgetting the key was a classic mistake.
senses.exampleCN: 忘带钥匙是个典型的错误。
senses.why: A standard example and a standard of excellence were once the same idea, so typical grew beside first-rate.
senses.whyCN: 标准范例与卓越标准原本是同一想法，于是典型义与一流义并行发展。

intro.en: Classic began as a rank word for the best Roman writers, then slid into praise of any lasting work.
intro.cn: classic 最初是给最好的罗马作家分等级的词，后来转为称赞任何经久不衰的作品。

items.en: Classicus described a citizen of the highest property class.

items.en: Scriptor classicus meant a first-rate writer.

items.en: Classique named the approved authors of antiquity.

items.en: English used classic for the best Greek and Latin works.
items.cn: 英语用 classic 指最优秀的希腊罗马作品。

items.en: The word widened to films, cars and typical mistakes.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到电影、汽车以及典型错误。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the classical family, while the meaning group names works and models worth copying.
note.cn: 形近组列出 classical 家族，近义组列出值得效仿的作品与范本。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the rank origin, the shelf image and the typical-mistake sense.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用等级来源、书架意象与典型错误义。

normal.en: Classic began as a rank word, so it means first class, not old-fashioned.
normal.cn: classic 起初是等级词，所以意思是一流，而不是老派。

normal.en: A classic is still read after the praise has faded, and that is the test.

normal.en: Classic is one letter shorter than classical, and it praises quality rather than ancient style.

normal.en: A classic mistake is typical, not excellent, so context decides the tone.
normal.cn: a classic mistake 指典型而非优秀，所以语气要靠语境判断。

normal.en: The plural classics names the literature of Greece and Rome.
normal.cn: 复数 classics 指希腊罗马的古典文献。

abstract.en: Picture a coach shaking his head at a mistake everyone predicted.
abstract.cn: 想象教练对所有人都预料到的失误摇头。

root: 源自拉丁语 classicus（最高等级的公民），短语 scriptor classicus 指第一流作家，经法语 classique 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: A rank of citizens becomes a rank of writers, then a lasting work, then anything typical.
sensesIntro.cn: 公民等级先变成作家等级，再变成传世作品，最后变成任何典型事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a worn masterpiece still standing on the top shelf.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本被翻旧的杰作仍立在书架顶层。

branches.en: The top rank gives the adjective its sense of excellence.
branches.cn: 最高等级给了这个形容词卓越的含义。

branches.en: The adjective becomes a noun for the work itself.
branches.cn: 形容词转成指作品本身的名词。

branches.en: A standard example can also be a bad one.

branches.en: Quality and the work that carries it share one word.
branches.cn: 品质与承载品质的作品共用一个词。

branches.en: Both senses rest on the idea of a model.
branches.cn: 两个义项都建立在范本这一概念上。

intro.en: The adjective grows a plural noun and a family of classical words.
intro.cn: 这个形容词长出复数名词与一组 classical 相关词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin classicus, of the highest class, so the whole family points back to rank.

senses.title: Of ancient Greece and Rome
senses.definition: belonging to the civilisation of ancient Greece and Rome
senses.definitionCN: 属于古希腊与古罗马文明的
senses.example: He reads classical texts in the original.
senses.exampleCN: 他读古典原著。
senses.why: The best writers of antiquity were the original classics, so their whole world became classical.
senses.whyCN: 上古最优秀的作家原本就是经典，于是他们的整个世界都被称为古典。

senses.title: Of a formal musical tradition
senses.definition: belonging to the serious European musical tradition from about seventeen fifty onwards
senses.definitionCN: 属于十八世纪中叶以来欧洲严肃音乐传统的
senses.example: She grew up listening to classical music.
senses.exampleCN: 她从小听古典音乐。
senses.why: Music that followed the old models of form and balance took the same label as ancient art.
senses.whyCN: 遵循旧有形式与均衡范本的音乐，借用了古代艺术的那个标签。

senses.title: Established as standard
senses.definition: long accepted as the standard form of a subject or method
senses.definitionCN: 长期被接受为某学科或方法的标准形式
senses.example: Classical physics fails at very small scales.
senses.exampleCN: 经典物理学在极小尺度上失效。
senses.why: What is taught as the old standard is called classical, in contrast with newer models.
senses.whyCN: 作为旧有标准被教授的内容被称为经典，以区别于更新的模型。

intro.en: Classical is the adjective of classic and keeps the idea of a first-rank model.

items.en: The word spread to architecture, art and then music.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到建筑、艺术，随后又扩展到音乐。

normal.en: Classical physics is the physics taught before relativity and quantum theory came along.

normal.en: The -al ending makes a word about a tradition, not about one admired example.

items.example: Classical comes from the word for class.

definition_zh: 教室；课堂（教学环境）
definition_en: a room in a school where a class is taught, or the teaching and learning that happens there
core_image: 黑板、成排课桌和一扇透进光的窗
scene: 下课铃响后，黑板上还留着半道没擦干净的算式。Twenty desks fill the classroom from wall to wall.
sceneCN: 这里 classroom 指「教室」（第 1 个义项：学校里上课的房间）；句意是二十张课桌从墙到墙塞满了这间教室。

senses.title: A room for lessons
senses.definition: a room in a school where a group of pupils is taught
senses.definitionCN: 学校里供一群学生上课的房间
senses.example: The classroom smells of chalk and floor polish.
senses.exampleCN: 这间教室里有粉笔和地板蜡的气味。
senses.why: The compound simply joins the group of pupils to the room that holds them.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词直接把学生群体与容纳他们的房间拼在一起。

senses.title: The setting for teaching
senses.definition: the teaching and learning that takes place in such a room
senses.definitionCN: 在这类房间里开展的教学与学习
senses.example: Technology has changed the classroom as much as the office.
senses.exampleCN: 技术对课堂的改变不亚于对办公室的改变。
senses.why: The room stands for the activity inside it, a common shift from place to practice.
senses.whyCN: 房间被用来代表其中的活动，这是从地点转向实践的常见引申。

intro.en: Classroom is a plain English compound of class and room, coined when schools began to sort pupils by age.
intro.cn: classroom 是 class 与 room 构成的普通英语复合词，在学校开始按年龄分班时出现。

items.en: Classis gave English the word class.
items.cn: classis 给了英语 class 一词。

items.en: Rum meant a space or a room.
items.cn: rum 意为空间或房间。

items.en: Class and room were joined for the schoolroom.
items.cn: class 与 room 组合起来指学校的上课房间。

items.en: The compound spread with public schooling.
items.cn: 随着公共教育普及，这个复合词传播开来。

items.en: It now also names the teaching practice itself.
items.cn: 它如今也指教学实践本身。

note.en: The look-alike group holds other class compounds, while the meaning group names rooms and settings for teaching.
note.cn: 形近组列出其他 class 复合词，近义组列出教学场所与场景。

entries.definition: a pupil in the same class as you
entries.definitionCN: 与你在同一个班的同学

entries.definition: work done by pupils during a lesson
entries.definitionCN: 学生在课上完成的作业

entries.definition: a group of pupils or a lesson
a room used for teaching in a school
entries.definitionCN: 学校里用于教学的房间

entries.definition: a large room for lectures at a college
entries.definitionCN: 大学里讲课用的大房间

entries.definition: a room used for reading and writing

normalIntro.en: These hooks split the compound and use the chalk-and-desks picture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子拆开这个复合词，并利用粉笔与课桌的画面。

normal.en: Classroom is class plus room, a room for the class.
normal.cn: classroom 是 class 加 room，即上课用的房间。

normal.en: The stress falls on class, so the two parts stay clearly separate.
normal.cn: 重音落在 class 上，因此两部分听起来界限分明。

normal.en: In the classroom takes the article, unlike in class.
normal.cn: in the classroom 要加冠词，而 in class 不加。

normal.en: The word can stand for the teaching itself, as in technology in the classroom.
normal.cn: 这个词可以代表教学本身，如 technology in the classroom。

normal.en: One stem gives class, classroom, classmate and classwork.
normal.cn: 一个词干长出了 class、classroom、classmate 与 classwork。

abstract.en: Picture a blackboard with a half-erased sum still showing.
abstract.cn: 想象黑板上还留着擦了一半的算式。

abstract.en: Picture twenty desks in rows with sunlight on the far wall.
abstract.cn: 想象二十张课桌排成行，阳光落在远墙上。

abstract.en: Picture a teacher's desk with a register and a box of chalk.
abstract.cn: 想象讲台上放着点名册和一盒粉笔。

examples.en: The classroom smells of chalk and floor polish.
examples.cn: 这间教室里有粉笔和地板蜡的气味。

examples.en: Twenty desks fill the classroom from wall to wall.
examples.cn: 二十张课桌从墙到墙塞满了这间教室。

examples.en: Technology has changed the classroom as much as the office.
examples.cn: 技术对课堂的改变不亚于对办公室的改变。

dict_mnemonic.text: class 是「班级」，room 是「房间」：一个班待的房间，就是教室。

root: 由 class（源自拉丁语 classis，划分）与 room（古英语 rum，空间）合成，指按班级上课的房间。

sensesIntro.en: First the room itself, then the teaching that fills it.
sensesIntro.cn: 先指房间本身，再指充满其中的教学活动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a blackboard, rows of desks and one bright window.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块黑板、成排课桌和一扇明亮的窗。

branches.en: The compound names the room that holds a class.
branches.cn: 这个复合词指容纳一个班级的房间。

branches.en: The room stands for the teaching inside it.
branches.cn: 房间被用来代表其中的教学。

branches.en: Place and practice share one word.
branches.cn: 地点与实践共用一个词。

branches.en: Desks and a board are the fixed furniture of the sense.
branches.cn: 课桌与黑板是这个义项的固定配置。

branches.en: Talking about the classroom means talking about how lessons work.
branches.cn: 谈论课堂就是在谈论课怎样进行。

intro.en: Two free words join to make one compound, and the class part feeds further compounds.
intro.cn: 两个自由词合成一个复合词，其中 class 部分又长出更多复合词。

latinIntro.en: Only the first half is Latin, from classis; the second half is native Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 只有前半部分来自拉丁语 classis，后半部分是英语本族的古英语词。

items.example: The classroom faces the playground.
items.exampleCN: 这间教室朝向操场。

items.example: The new wing has eight classrooms.
items.exampleCN: 新楼有八间教室。

items.meaning: a group of pupils or a lesson

items.exampleCN: 这节课八点开始。

items.example: The room has two windows.
items.exampleCN: 这间房有两扇窗。

items.example: A classmate lent me a pen.
items.exampleCN: 一位同学借给我一支笔。

items.example: Finish the classwork at home.
items.exampleCN: 回家把课堂作业做完。

items.example: The course is classroom-based.
items.exampleCN: 这门课以课堂授课为主。

items.meaning: a room used for a stated purpose
items.example: The suffix -room builds classroom and bedroom.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -room 构成 classroom 与 bedroom。

latinEntries.example: Classis is the first half of classroom.
latinEntries.exampleCN: classis 是 classroom 的前半部分。

definition_zh: 干净的；清洁的；彻底的；打扫；清洗
definition_en: free from dirt or marks, complete and thorough, or to remove dirt from something
core_image: 擦过后能照出窗影的桌面
scene: 客人按门铃前，她把最后一本书塞回书架。She wiped the table until it was clean.
sceneCN: 这里 clean 指「干净的」（第 1 个义项：没有污垢或痕迹）；句意是她把桌子擦到干干净净。

senses.title: Free from dirt
senses.definition: not marked or covered with dirt, and safe to use
senses.definitionCN: 没有污迹或污垢、可以放心使用的
senses.example: Wash your hands and keep the kitchen clean.
senses.exampleCN: 洗手，并保持厨房干净。
senses.why: The old English adjective meant free from dirt and also pure, and both senses travelled together.
senses.whyCN: 这个古英语形容词既指没有污垢，也指纯净，两个含义一路同行。

senses.title: To remove dirt
senses.definition: to remove dirt from something by washing or wiping
senses.definitionCN: 通过洗或擦去除某物上的污垢
senses.example: He cleaned the windows before lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 午饭前他把窗户擦了。
senses.why: The adjective turned into a verb meaning to make something clean.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词转为动词，意为使某物变干净。

senses.title: Complete and thorough
senses.definition: done fully, with nothing left out or hidden
senses.definitionCN: 做得彻底，没有遗漏也没有隐瞒
senses.example: The team made a clean break with the old plan.
senses.exampleCN: 团队与旧方案彻底断了关系。
senses.why: Something clean has nothing sticking to it, so a clean break leaves no loose ends.
senses.whyCN: 干净的东西不粘带杂物，因此 clean break 指不留尾巴的切割。

intro.en: Clean is an old English adjective meaning free of dirt and also pure or clear.
intro.cn: clean 是古英语形容词，既指没有污垢，也指纯净、清楚。

items.en: Clæne meant clean, pure and clear.
items.cn: clæne 意为干净的、纯净的、清楚的。

items.en: The word kept the physical and moral senses together.
items.cn: 这个词把物质义与道德义保留在一起。

items.en: The verb clean appeared, meaning to make clean.
items.cn: 动词 clean 出现，意为使干净。

items.en: Clean up became a common phrase for tidying.
items.cn: clean up 成为表示收拾整理的常用短语。

items.en: The word now also describes energy and technology.
items.cn: 这个词如今也形容能源与技术。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in spelling, while the meaning group names states of order and purity.
note.cn: 形近组列出拼写接近的词，近义组列出整洁与纯净的状态。

entries.definition: easy to see through or to understand
entries.definitionCN: 容易看透或容易理解的

entries.definition: to clean something thoroughly, often the skin
in a neat and skilful way
arranged neatly with everything in place
not mixed with anything harmful
to clean something with water

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the wiped surface, the verb pair and the thorough sense.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用擦净的表面、名动搭配与彻底义。

normal.en: Clean is one syllable with a long vowel, so it sounds like a wiped surface shining.
normal.cn: clean 是长元音的单音节词，听起来像擦净的桌面在发亮。

normal.en: The adjective and the verb are identical: a clean room, to clean a room.
normal.cn: 形容词与动词同形：a clean room 与 to clean a room。

normal.en: Clean up is for mess, clean out is for a cupboard, clean off is for a surface.
normal.cn: clean up 收拾乱局，clean out 清空柜子，clean off 擦净表面。

normal.en: A clean break leaves no shared habit behind.
normal.cn: clean break 指不留下共同习惯的彻底了断。

normal.en: Clean energy is energy that leaves no dirt behind.
normal.cn: clean energy 指不留下污物的能源。

abstract.en: Picture a table wiped so well that the window appears in it.
abstract.cn: 想象桌面被擦到能映出窗户。

abstract.en: Picture a white cup upside down on a dry rack.
abstract.cn: 想象一只倒扣在沥水架上的白杯子。

abstract.en: Picture a knife cut through paper with no ragged edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一刀切过纸面，边缘没有毛刺。

examples.en: Wash your hands and keep the kitchen clean.
examples.cn: 洗手，并保持厨房干净。

examples.en: He cleaned the windows before lunch.
examples.cn: 午饭前他把窗户擦了。

examples.en: The team made a clean break with the old plan.
examples.cn: 团队与旧方案彻底断了关系。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cl 想成「擦」，ean 想成「亮」：一擦就亮，就是干净。

root: 源自古英语 clæne（没有污垢的、纯净的、清楚的），与德语 klein 的古老含义相关，后由形容词生出动词用法。

sensesIntro.en: Free of dirt becomes an action, and then the idea of leaving nothing behind.
sensesIntro.cn: 没有污垢先是状态，再变成动作，最后引申为不留残余。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wiped table reflecting the window.
core.cn: 核心意象：擦净的桌面映出窗户。

branches.en: The adjective names a surface with nothing on it.
branches.cn: 形容词指表面没有任何附着物。

branches.en: The verb names the work of removing dirt.
branches.cn: 动词指去除污垢的劳动。

branches.en: Nothing left over becomes a thorough break.
branches.cn: 不留残余引申为彻底了断。

branches.en: State and action differ only by the work in between.
branches.cn: 状态与动作只差中间那段劳动。

branches.en: Both senses rest on the absence of anything extra.
branches.cn: 两个义项都建立在没有多余之物上。

intro.en: One short adjective grows a comparative, a verb set and four derived nouns and adverbs.
intro.cn: 一个短形容词长出比较级、一整套动词形式以及四个派生名词与副词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base: clean is a native English word.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语词基：clean 是英语本族词。

items.meaning: free of dirt or to remove dirt
items.example: The cup is clean.
items.exampleCN: 杯子是干净的。

items.example: This cloth is cleaner.
items.exampleCN: 这块布更干净。

items.example: It is the cleanest room in the house.
items.exampleCN: 这是家里最干净的房间。

items.meaning: the verb with a single subject

items.exampleCN: 她每晚都擦黑板。

items.example: He is cleaning the windows.
items.exampleCN: 他正在擦窗户。

items.example: The kitchen is praised for its cleanliness.
items.exampleCN: 这间厨房因干净而受称赞。

items.meaning: in a neat and skilful way
items.example: The branch broke cleanly.
items.exampleCN: 树枝断得很利落。

definition_zh: 清洁工；清洁剂；清洁器；更干净的
definition_en: a person whose job is cleaning; a substance or machine used for cleaning; the comparative of clean
core_image: 推着拖把的车，把楼道擦亮的人
scene: 清晨的走廊里，保洁阿姨推着水车慢慢走过。The cleaner washed the floor before class.
sceneCN: 这里 cleaner 是「清洁工」（第 1 个义项：以打扫为业的人）；句意是上课前清洁工清洗了地板。

pos.zh: 更干净的（clean 的比较级）

derivatives.zh: cleaner 的基础词，义为「干净的」
由 clean 加后缀 -ing 构成，义为「清扫；清洁工作」

senses.title: A person whose job is cleaning
senses.definition: a person employed to keep places clean
senses.definitionCN: 受雇保持场所干净的人
senses.example: The cleaner arrives at six every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 清洁工每天早晨六点到位。
senses.why: The agent suffix -er turns the action into the doer.
senses.whyCN: 施动后缀 -er 把动作变成做动作的人。

senses.title: A substance or machine for cleaning
senses.definition: a product or device used to remove dirt
senses.definitionCN: 用来清除污垢的物品或装置
senses.example: Spray some cleaner on the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 往桌上喷点清洁剂。
senses.why: The same suffix names a tool that performs the action.
senses.whyCN: 同一个后缀也命名执行该动作的工具。

senses.title: The comparative of clean
senses.definition: more clean than something else
senses.definitionCN: 比另一物更干净
senses.example: This classroom is cleaner than ours.
senses.exampleCN: 这间教室比我们的干净。
senses.why: Adding -er to the adjective builds its comparative form.
senses.whyCN: 形容词加 -er 构成比较级形式。

intro.en: Cleaner simply adds the old agent suffix -er to clean.
intro.cn: cleaner 就是在 clean 后加上古老的施动后缀 -er。

items.en: Old English clæne meant clean and pure.
items.cn: 古英语 clæne 义为干净、纯洁。

items.en: Old English -ere was a suffix for the person doing something.
items.cn: 古英语后缀 -ere 表示做某事的人。

items.en: Middle English combined them as clenere, a person who cleans.
items.cn: 中古英语合为 clenere，指打扫的人。

items.en: Modern English kept cleaner for people and tools alike.
items.cn: 现代英语用 cleaner 兼指人和工具。

items.en: The comparative use of cleaner grew alongside.
items.cn: cleaner 的比较级用法随之发展。

note.en: The first group gathers cleaning words; the second gathers look-alikes.
note.cn: 第一组收清洁类词，第二组收形近词。

entries.definition: A person cleaning a building, American usage.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，美式义为「大楼清洁管理员」。

entries.definition: A soap powder for washing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「洗涤剂」，与清洁剂同类。

normalIntro.en: Remember cleaner through its two jobs.
normalIntro.cn: 记住 cleaner 的两种身份。

normal.en: cleaner can be a person or a product.
normal.cn: cleaner 可指人也可指清洁剂。

normal.en: -er marks the doer of an action.
normal.cn: -er 标记动作的执行者。

normal.en: vacuum cleaner is the machine for floors.
normal.cn: vacuum cleaner 指吸尘器。

normal.en: cleaner is also the comparative of clean.
normal.cn: cleaner 也是 clean 的比较级。

normal.cn: the cleaner's 指干洗店。

abstract.en: See a mop swinging across a long corridor.
abstract.cn: 想象拖把在长走廊上来回摆动。

abstract.en: Hear the soft hum of a vacuum at dawn.
abstract.cn: 仿佛听见清晨吸尘器的低鸣。

abstract.en: Feel fresh air after a wiped window opens.
abstract.cn: 感受擦净的窗户打开后的清新空气。

examples.cn: 学校的清洁工把大厅保持得很明亮。

examples.en: Add a little cleaner to the water.
examples.cn: 往水里加一点清洁剂。

examples.en: After the rain, the streets are much cleaner.
examples.cn: 雨后街道干净多了。

core_image: 雾散后一条条显出来的山脊
scene: 雾散开，远处的山脊一条条显出来。The sky became clear just before sunset.
sceneCN: 这里 clear 指「晴朗的；清澈的」（第 2 个义项：没有云雾遮挡、透明可见）；句意是日落前天空放晴了。

senses.title: Easy to understand
senses.definition: expressed in a way that leaves no doubt or confusion
senses.definitionCN: 表达得没有疑问或混乱的
senses.example: Her instructions were short and clear.
senses.exampleCN: 她的指示简短而清楚。
senses.why: The Latin base meant bright, and a bright room lets you see everything without strain.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词基本义是明亮的，明亮的房间让人不费力就能看清一切。

senses.title: Transparent or cloudless
senses.definition: easy to see through, or free of cloud and mist
senses.definitionCN: 容易看透的，或没有云和雾的
senses.example: The lake was clear down to the stones.
senses.exampleCN: 湖水清得能看见水底的石头。
senses.why: This is the oldest physical sense: nothing stands between the eye and the thing.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的具体义：眼睛与物体之间没有任何遮挡。

senses.title: To remove what blocks
senses.definition: to remove objects or obstacles from a place so that it is free
senses.definitionCN: 把物体或障碍从某处移走使之空出
senses.example: Please clear the boxes from the hallway.
senses.exampleCN: 请把走廊上的箱子清走。
senses.why: To make a place clear is to take away what blocks the view or the way.
senses.whyCN: 使一个地方 clear，就是把挡住视线或通道的东西拿走。

intro.en: Clear comes from the Latin adjective for bright, which also gave clarify and clarity.
intro.cn: clear 出自拉丁语表示明亮的形容词，clarify 与 clarity 也来自它。

items.en: Clarus meant bright, clear or famous.
items.cn: clarus 意为明亮的、清澈的或闻名的。

items.en: Cler meant bright and also free of guilt.
items.cn: cler 意为明亮的，也指无罪的。

items.en: English used clear for light, water and speech.
items.cn: 英语用 clear 形容光、水与言语。

items.en: The verb appeared, meaning to make a place free.
items.cn: 动词形式出现，意为使某处空出来。

items.en: The word now also covers permissions and profits.
items.cn: 这个词如今也用于许可与净利。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the clarity family, while the meaning group names what can be seen or understood easily.
note.cn: 形近组列出 clarity 家族，近义组列出容易看见或理解的状态。

entries.definition: free from dirt
to make something easier to understand
the quality of being easy to follow
so plain that no one can miss it
allowing light through so things behind are seen

entries.definition: simple and easy to understand

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the bright root, the weather sense and the clearing verb.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用明亮词根、天气义与清理动词。

normal.en: Clear, clarify and clarity all carry Latin brightness.
normal.cn: clear、clarify、clarity 都带着拉丁语的明亮。

normal.en: A clear sky, clear water and a clear sentence all lack something in the way.
normal.cn: 晴空、清水与清楚的句子，都是路上少了遮挡。

normal.en: To clear a table is to make its surface visible again.
normal.cn: clear a table 就是让桌面重新露出来。

normal.en: Clear up can mean the sky opening or a mess being tidied.
normal.cn: clear up 既可指天放晴，也可指把乱局收拾好。

normal.en: The comparative is clearer, with the r sound doubled in spelling.
normal.cn: 比较级是 clearer，拼写里 r 音连在一起。

abstract.en: Picture mist lifting off a ridge line one fold at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象雾气从山脊上一层一层退开。

abstract.en: Picture a lake so transparent that stones look close.
abstract.cn: 想象湖水透明到石头看着很近。

abstract.en: Picture a bare table with only light on it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张空桌上只剩光。

examples.en: Her instructions were short and clear.
examples.cn: 她的指示简短而清楚。

examples.en: The sky became clear just before sunset.
examples.cn: 日落前天空放晴了。

examples.en: Please clear the boxes from the hallway.
examples.cn: 请把走廊上的箱子清走。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cl 想成「澈」，ear 想成「耳」：清澈到耳朵都听得见回声，就是清楚。

root: 源自拉丁语 clarus（明亮的、清楚的），经古法语 cler 进入英语，由光亮义扩展为明白、透明与清除。

sensesIntro.en: Brightness first lets you see through, then lets you understand, then lets you remove what blocks.
sensesIntro.cn: 明亮先让你看透，再让你听懂，最后让你把挡路的东西搬走。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ridges appearing as mist lifts.
core.cn: 核心意象：雾散时山脊一条条显现。

branches.en: Brightness of light becomes brightness of meaning.
branches.cn: 光的明亮变成意义的明白。

branches.en: The physical sense keeps air and water free of cloud.
branches.cn: 具体义指空气与水没有云雾。

branches.en: To clear is to remove what stands in the way.
branches.cn: 清除就是搬走挡路之物。

branches.en: Both let something pass without distortion.
branches.cn: 两者都让某物无失真地通过。

branches.en: A cleared space is as open as a clear sky.
branches.cn: 清空的地方像晴空一样开阔。

intro.en: The short adjective grows a comparative, a verb set and four derived words.
intro.cn: 这个短形容词长出比较级、动词形式以及四个派生词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin clarus, bright, which also underlies clarify and clarity.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 clarus（明亮的），clarify 与 clarity 也源于它。

items.meaning: easy to see or to remove from
items.example: The water is clear.
items.exampleCN: 水是清澈的。

items.example: The picture is clearer now.
items.exampleCN: 图像现在更清楚了。

items.example: This is the clearest map.
items.exampleCN: 这是最清楚的一张地图。

items.meaning: the verb with a single subject
items.example: He clears the desk each night.
items.exampleCN: 他每晚都把桌子收拾干净。

items.example: They cleared the road by noon.
items.exampleCN: 他们中午前把路清开了。

items.example: She is clearing the shelves.
items.exampleCN: 她正在清空架子。

items.meaning: the removing or the space left
items.example: The lorry needs more clearance.
items.exampleCN: 这辆卡车需要更大的净空。

items.meaning: in a way easy to follow
items.example: He spoke clearly.
items.exampleCN: 他讲得很清楚。

latinEntries.example: Clarus is the root of clear.
latinEntries.exampleCN: clarus 是 clear 的词根。

definition_zh: 清楚地；明显地；显然
definition_en: in a way that is easy to see, hear or understand, or used to say that something is obviously true
core_image: 一句话穿过整间教室，落到最后一排
scene: 讲解的人放慢速度，每个字都传到最后一排。She spoke clearly enough for everyone at the back.
sceneCN: 这里 clearly 指「清楚地」（第 1 个义项：以容易听清、看懂的方式）；句意是她讲得足够清楚，后排每个人都听得见。

senses.title: In an easy-to-follow way
senses.definition: in a way that is easy to hear, see or understand
senses.definitionCN: 以容易听见、看见或理解的方式
senses.example: Please say your name clearly into the phone.
senses.exampleCN: 请对着电话把名字说清楚。
senses.why: The adverb simply describes how an action is done, and it inherits the brightness of clear.
senses.whyCN: 副词只是描述动作怎样进行，它继承了 clear 的明亮含义。

senses.title: Without any doubt
senses.definition: used to state that something is obviously true
senses.definitionCN: 用于说明某事显然为真
senses.example: Clearly, the plan will cost more than expected.
senses.exampleCN: 显然，这个方案的花费会超出预期。
senses.why: What is seen clearly needs no argument, so the adverb came to mark an obvious conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 看得清楚的事无需论证，于是这个副词用来标记显而易见的结论。

intro.en: Clearly is clear plus the old English adverb ending, and it keeps the brightness image.
intro.cn: clearly 是 clear 加古英语副词词尾，保留了明亮的意象。

items.en: Clarus meant bright or clear.
items.cn: clarus 意为明亮的或清楚的。

items.en: The ending -lice turned adjectives into adverbs.
items.cn: 词尾 -lice 把形容词变成副词。

items.en: The ending became -ly and clearly took its place.
items.cn: 词尾变为 -ly，clearly 由此定型。

items.en: Writers used clearly to open an obvious statement.
items.cn: 作家用 clearly 引出一个显而易见的论断。

items.en: The word works both as a manner adverb and a sentence adverb.
items.cn: 这个词既作方式副词，也作句子副词。

note.en: The look-alike group holds forms built on clear, while the meaning group holds adverbs of plainness.
note.cn: 形近组列出由 clear 构成的 forms，近义组列出表示明白的副词。

entries.definition: easy to see or understand
in a neat and skilful way
easier to see or understand
in a way anyone can see
entries.definitionCN: 以任何人都看得出的方式

entries.definition: simply and without decoration
in a way that is easy to notice

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the -ly pattern, the two positions in a sentence and the brightness image.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 -ly 构词、句中两个位置以及明亮意象。

normal.en: Clearly is clear plus -ly, so it describes the manner of an action.
normal.cn: clearly 是 clear 加 -ly，描述动作的方式。

normal.en: At the end of a sentence it tells how; at the front it tells you what to conclude.
normal.cn: 放在句末说明怎样做，放在句首告诉你该得出什么结论。

normal.en: Speak clearly is about sound, see clearly is about sight, think clearly is about mind.
normal.cn: speak clearly 关乎声音，see clearly 关乎视觉，think clearly 关乎头脑。

normal.en: Clearly wrong is a polite way to say obviously wrong.
normal.cn: clearly wrong 是 obviously wrong 的客气说法。

normal.en: The word has no comparative form, so one says more clearly.
normal.cn: 这个词没有比较级形式，因此说 more clearly。

abstract.en: Picture a voice crossing a whole classroom and landing at the back row.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音穿过整间教室落到最后一排。

abstract.en: Picture a line of print sharp enough to read from a step away.
abstract.cn: 想象一行字清晰到退开一步仍能读。

abstract.en: Picture a hand lifting a curtain so the view is plain.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手拉开窗帘，景色一目了然。

examples.en: She spoke clearly enough for everyone at the back.
examples.cn: 她讲得足够清楚，后排每个人都听得见。

examples.en: The sign is clearly visible from the road.
examples.cn: 从路上就能清楚看见这块牌子。

examples.en: Clearly, the plan will cost more than expected.
examples.cn: 显然，这个方案的花费会超出预期。

dict_mnemonic.text: clear 是「清楚」，ly 是「地」：清楚地，就是把话说到人人都懂。

root: 由 clear（源自拉丁语 clarus，明亮的）加古英语副词词尾 -lice（今 -ly）构成。

sensesIntro.en: First the manner of seeing or speaking, then the certainty of a conclusion.
sensesIntro.cn: 先指看或说的方式，再指结论的确定无疑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a voice reaching the last row without effort.
core.cn: 核心意象：声音毫不费力地传到最后一排。

branches.en: The adverb describes a clear manner of acting.
branches.cn: 这个副词描述清楚的行事方式。

branches.en: It also marks a conclusion that needs no proof.
branches.cn: 它也标记无需证明的结论。

branches.en: Both rest on the idea that nothing blocks the view.
branches.cn: 两者都建立在没有遮挡视线这一想法上。

branches.en: Sound, sight and thought can all be done clearly.
branches.cn: 声音、视觉与思考都可以做得清楚。

branches.en: A clearly seen fact ends an argument.
branches.cn: 看清的事实能终止争论。

intro.en: The adverb is built from clear plus -ly and sits in a small family of clear words.
intro.cn: 这个副词由 clear 加 -ly 构成，属于 clear 的小家族。

latinIntro.en: The base goes back through French to Latin clarus, bright.
latinIntro.cn: 词基经法语上溯到拉丁语 clarus（明亮的）。

items.example: He explained it clearly.
items.exampleCN: 他把它解释得很清楚。

items.example: The rule is clear.
items.exampleCN: 规则很清楚。

items.example: The second draft is clearer.
items.exampleCN: 第二稿更清楚。

items.example: This is the clearest example.
items.exampleCN: 这是最清楚的例子。

items.example: The essay is praised for clarity.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章因清晰而受称赞。

items.example: The clearness of the water surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 水的清澈让我们惊讶。

items.example: She clarified the rule.
items.exampleCN: 她把这个规则讲清楚了。

items.example: Clear plus -ly gives clearly.
items.exampleCN: clear 加 -ly 得到 clearly。

latinEntries.exampleCN: clarus 是 clearly 的远祖。

definition_zh: 职员；办事员；店员；售货员
definition_en: a person who keeps records or does office work, or a person who serves customers in a shop
core_image: 柜台后低头抄写、核对的账本
scene: 柜台前排了几个人，机打的单据一张张吐出来。The bank clerk counted the notes twice.
sceneCN: 这里 clerk 指「职员」（第 1 个义项：在办公室或柜台处理记录与事务的人）；句意是那位银行职员把钞票点了两遍。

senses.title: A person who keeps records
senses.definition: a person employed to keep records, file papers or do other office work
senses.definitionCN: 受雇保管记录、整理文件或做其他办公室事务的人
senses.example: The clerk stamped the form and filed it.
senses.exampleCN: 那位职员在表格上盖了章并归档。
senses.why: The word once meant a clergyman, then any person who could read and write, and later an office worker.
senses.whyCN: 这个词曾指教士，后指任何会读写的人，再后来指办公室职员。

senses.title: A shop assistant
senses.definition: a person who serves customers behind a counter, especially in American use
senses.definitionCN: 在柜台后接待顾客的人，尤用于美式英语
senses.example: The clerk wrapped the gift in blue paper.
senses.exampleCN: 店员用蓝纸把礼物包好。
senses.why: Selling behind a counter was also record work, so the same word covered shop staff.
senses.whyCN: 柜台后卖货同样涉及记账，于是同一个词也指店员。

intro.en: Clerk began as the word for a clergyman, since clergy were almost the only people who could read and write.
intro.cn: clerk 起初指教士，因为当时几乎只有教士会读写。

items.en: Kleros meant a lot or a share, including a share of church duty.
items.cn: kleros 意为抽签所得的一份，也包括教会职务的一份。

items.en: Clericus meant a man of the church.
items.cn: clericus 指教会中人。

items.en: Cleric named a priest or a scholar.
items.cn: cleric 指教士或学者。

items.en: Clerk meant a scholar or a secretary, then any office worker.
items.cn: clerk 指学者或书记，后指任何办公人员。

items.en: American use added the shop assistant sense.
items.cn: 美式用法又加上了店员义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds church and writing words, while the meaning group names people who serve at a counter or desk.
note.cn: 形近组列出教会与文书类词，近义组列出在柜台或桌前服务的人。

entries.definition: relating to office work or to clergy
entries.definitionCN: 与办公室工作或教士有关的

entries.definition: the body of people trained for religious work
entries.definitionCN: 受过宗教训练的人员群体

entries.definition: easy to see or understand
a person who helps someone else at work
entries.definitionCN: 在工作中帮助他人的人

entries.definition: a person who greets visitors at a front desk
entries.definitionCN: 在前台接待来访者的人

entries.definition: a bank worker who handles money at a counter
entries.definitionCN: 在柜台处理现金的银行职员

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the clergy origin, the reading skill and the counter picture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用教士来源、读写能力与柜台画面。

normal.en: Clerk and clergy share a root: the clerk was the church's reader and writer.
normal.cn: clerk 与 clergy 同根：当年的 clerk 就是教会里读写的人。

normal.en: Because clerks could read, the word came to mean any keeper of records.
normal.cn: 因为 clerk 会读写，这个词后来指任何管记录的人。

normal.en: In Britain a clerk sits in an office; in America a clerk often stands at a shop counter.
normal.cn: 在英国 clerk 多坐办公室，在美国常站在商店柜台后。

normal.en: The British say klark and the Americans say klerk, and both spell it clerk.
normal.cn: 英音读 klark，美音读 klerk，拼写都是 clerk。

normal.en: Clerical work means paperwork, not church work, in most modern offices.
normal.cn: 在多数现代办公室里，clerical work 指文书工作而非教会工作。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger, an ink pad and a rubber stamp on a high desk.
abstract.cn: 想象高桌上放着账本、印泥和一枚橡皮章。

abstract.en: Picture a queue of people and a printer spitting out receipts.
abstract.cn: 想象排着队的顾客和一台不断吐出单据的打印机。

abstract.en: Picture a man in a black coat copying a letter by hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一位穿黑衣的人手抄一封信。

examples.en: The clerk stamped the form and filed it.
examples.cn: 那位职员在表格上盖了章并归档。

examples.en: The bank clerk counted the notes twice.
examples.cn: 那位银行职员把钞票点了两遍。

examples.en: The clerk wrapped the gift in blue paper.
examples.cn: 店员用蓝纸把礼物包好。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cl 想成「抄」，erk 想成「额」：低头抄到额头出汗的人，就是职员。

root: 源自希腊语 kleros（抽签所得的一份）经拉丁语 clericus（教会中人）进入英语，由教士义转为会读写的人，再转为职员。

sensesIntro.en: A clergyman becomes a literate secretary, then an office worker, then a shop assistant.
sensesIntro.cn: 教士先变成会写字的书记，再变成办公室职员，最后指店员。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ledger, an ink pad and a stamp on a high desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：高桌上的账本、印泥与图章。

branches.en: The record keeper sits at a desk with paper.
branches.cn: 管记录的人坐在桌前与纸打交道。

branches.en: The counter worker serves customers and keeps accounts.
branches.cn: 柜台人员接待顾客并记账。

branches.en: Both senses rest on handling papers and figures.
branches.cn: 两个义项都建立在处理单据与数字上。

branches.en: Reading and writing were once the clerk's special skill.
branches.cn: 读写曾是 clerk 的独门本事。

branches.en: The American shop sense grew from counter paperwork.
branches.cn: 美式的店员义从柜台记账发展而来。

intro.en: The noun takes a plural and grows an adjective and two nouns of role.
intro.cn: 这个名词接复数，并长出形容词与两个身份名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin clericus, a churchman, from Greek kleros, a lot or share.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 clericus（教会中人），源自希腊语 kleros（一份）。

items.meaningCN: 办公室或商店的工作人员
items.example: The clerk asked for my name.

items.exampleCN: 三名职员共用这个柜台。

items.example: Clerical errors delayed the order.
items.exampleCN: 文书错误耽误了订单。

items.example: He took a clerkship in the city.
items.exampleCN: 他在城里谋得一个文员职位。

latinEntries.example: Clericus is the source of clerk.
