definition_zh: 聪明的；机灵的；（办法、主意）巧妙的
definition_en: quick at learning and understanding, or skilful and original in the way something is done
core_image: 孩子把厚书垫在椅子上够到高处的柜子
scene: 孩子把椅子拖到柜子前，又垫上一本厚书。It was a clever way to reach the top shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 clever 指「巧妙的」（第 2 个义项：办法机敏而别出心裁）；句意那是个够到顶层架子的巧妙办法。

senses.title: Quick at learning
senses.definition: able to learn and understand things quickly and well
senses.definitionCN: 能够又快又好地学会并理解事物的
senses.example: She is clever enough to see the trap.
senses.exampleCN: 她聪明得能看出这个陷阱。
senses.why: The word first described a quick hand or a quick mind, and the mental sense won out.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初形容手快或脑子快，后来心智义占了上风。

senses.title: Skilfully thought out
senses.definition: showing skill and imagination in the way a problem is solved
senses.definitionCN: 在解决某个问题的方式上显出技巧与巧思
senses.example: The lock has a clever little catch.
senses.exampleCN: 这把锁有个巧妙的小卡扣。
senses.why: A clever device shows the same quickness as a clever person, but in an object.
senses.whyCN: 巧妙的装置展现了与聪明人同样的机敏，只不过体现在物件上。

intro.en: The origin of clever is uncertain; it appears in Middle English meaning nimble with the hands.
intro.cn: clever 的来源并不确定，中古英语中出现时意为手很灵巧。

items.en: Cliver meant quick and neat with the hands.
items.cn: cliver 意为手上动作快而利落。

items.en: The word spread to the mind as well as the hands.
items.cn: 这个词从手扩展到头脑。

items.en: Clever settled as the everyday word for bright.
items.cn: clever 定型为表示聪明的日常词。

items.en: A critical tone appeared in phrases like too clever.
items.cn: 像 too clever 这样的说法带出了批评口气。

items.en: The word now also praises a neat solution or design.
items.cn: 这个词如今也称赞巧妙的解法或设计。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words with a similar shape but other meanings, while the meaning group names mental sharpness.
note.cn: 形近组列出外形相近但意义不同的词，近义组列出头脑敏锐。

entries.definition: a heavy knife for chopping meat
to split something with a sharp blow
in a smart and skilful way
quick in thinking and learning
intelligent and quick to understand
very clever and original in design
entries.definitionCN: 设计上非常聪明且有创意的

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the quick-hands origin, the two senses and the mild warning in too clever.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用手巧来源、两个义项以及 too clever 的轻微警告。

normal.en: Clever began with clever hands and moved to a clever head.
normal.cn: clever 起于手巧，后来转向头脑灵。

normal.en: A clever person and a clever lock show the same neatness.
normal.cn: 聪明的人与巧妙的锁展现同一种利落。

normal.en: Clever is not quite wise: it praises speed, not judgement.
normal.cn: clever 不等于 wise：它称赞的是快，而不是判断力。

normal.en: Too clever by half means someone has outsmarted himself.
normal.cn: too clever by half 指聪明反被聪明误。

normal.en: The comparative doubles nothing: cleverer and cleverest keep one l.
normal.cn: 比较级与最高级不加倍写 l：cleverer、cleverest。

abstract.en: Picture a child stacking a thick book on a chair to reach a jar.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子把厚书垫在椅子上够一个罐子。

abstract.en: Picture a lid that opens with one twist and no tools.
abstract.cn: 想象一个一拧就开、不用工具的盖子。

abstract.en: Picture a knot that holds under load and slips free with one pull.
abstract.cn: 想象一个受力不散、一拉就开的绳结。

examples.en: She is clever enough to see the trap.
examples.cn: 她聪明得能看出这个陷阱。

examples.en: It was a clever way to reach the top shelf.
examples.cn: 那是个够到顶层架子的巧妙办法。

examples.en: The lock has a clever little catch.
examples.cn: 这把锁有个巧妙的小卡扣。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cle 想成「撬」，ver 想成「弯」：会撬会弯着想法子的人，就是机灵。

root: 中古英语作 cliver，可能源自古英语表示灵巧的词，本义是手快而利落，后转指头脑敏捷。

sensesIntro.en: Quick hands come first, then a quick mind, then a neatly made thing.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是手快，再是脑快，最后指做得巧妙的物件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a book stacked on a chair to reach a high shelf.
core.cn: 核心意象：把书垫在椅子上够到高架。

branches.en: The old hand sense becomes a quick mind.
branches.cn: 旧日的手巧义变成头脑敏捷。

branches.en: A solution can be clever without being a person.
branches.cn: 解法可以很巧妙，而不必是人。

branches.en: People and devices share the same neat skill.
branches.cn: 人与装置共享同一种利落的技巧。

branches.en: Clever praises speed of learning, not depth of wisdom.
branches.cn: clever 称赞学习快，而不是智慧深。

branches.en: A clever trick may also be slightly dishonest.
branches.cn: 巧妙的把戏也可能略微不老实。

intro.en: The adjective takes two inflections and grows an adverb and a noun.
intro.cn: 这个形容词有两种屈折形式，并长出副词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base: clever appears in Middle English with an uncertain origin.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语词基：clever 见于中古英语，来源不明。

items.example: That is a clever answer.
items.exampleCN: 那是个聪明的回答。

items.example: He is cleverer than he looks.
items.exampleCN: 他比看上去更聪明。

items.example: She is the cleverest in the class.
items.exampleCN: 她是班上最聪明的。

items.example: The box opens cleverly.
items.exampleCN: 这个盒子开得很巧。

items.example: The plan shows real cleverness.
items.exampleCN: 这个方案显出真本事。

items.meaning: a smart but possibly unfair act
items.meaningCN: 巧妙但可能不老实的做法
items.example: It was a clever trick with the cards.
items.exampleCN: 那是玩牌时的一个巧妙把戏。

items.example: She is clever with her hands.
items.exampleCN: 她手很巧。

items.example: Clever plus -ness gives cleverness.
items.exampleCN: clever 加 -ness 得到 cleverness。

definition_zh: 点击；发出咔嗒声；突然明白
definition_en: to press a button on a mouse or other device, to make a short sharp sound, or to become suddenly clear in the mind
core_image: 手指按下鼠标键时那一声轻脆的咔嗒
scene: 她把光标移到图标上，手腕轻轻一动。Click the green button to start the test.
sceneCN: 这里 click 指「点击」（第 1 个义项：按下鼠标键）；句意是点击绿色按钮开始测试。

senses.title: Press a mouse button
senses.definition: to press a button on a computer mouse in order to choose something
senses.definitionCN: 按下电脑鼠标的按键以选中某个对象
senses.example: Click the blue button to save your work.
senses.exampleCN: 点击蓝色按钮保存你的工作。
senses.why: The mouse answers with a small snap, so the action took the name of its own sound.
senses.whyCN: 鼠标按下时会发出一声轻响，于是动作借用了自己发出的声音。

senses.title: Short sharp sound
senses.definition: a short sharp sound made when two hard things touch
senses.definitionCN: 两个硬物相碰时发出的短促声响
senses.example: The click of the latch told her that the door was shut.
senses.exampleCN: 门闩的咔嗒声告诉她门已关好。
senses.why: Long before computers, the word belonged to locks, switches and heels.
senses.whyCN: 在计算机出现以前很久，这个词属于锁、开关和鞋跟。

senses.title: Sudden understanding
senses.definition: to become suddenly clear or easy to understand
senses.definitionCN: 突然变得清楚、容易理解
senses.example: Her explanation made the whole rule click.
senses.exampleCN: 她的解释让整条规则一下子通了。
senses.why: A thought seems to snap into place like a latch, so the sound image moved into the mind.
senses.whyCN: 思路像锁扣一样咔一下合上，声音意象便迁移到了头脑中。

intro.en: Click is not borrowed from Latin or Greek; it simply imitates a small sharp noise.
intro.cn: click 并非借自拉丁语或希腊语，它只是模仿一种短促的脆响。

items.en: The word copies the sound of a latch, a key or a small hammer.
items.cn: 这个词模仿门闩、钥匙或小锤发出的声音。

items.en: Click first named the sound made by locks and clock parts.
items.cn: click 最初指锁与钟表零件发出的声响。

items.en: Switches, heels and typewriters widened the range of the sound.
items.cn: 开关、鞋跟与打字机扩大了这种声音的适用范围。

items.en: The computer mouse gave the word a new everyday action.
items.cn: 电脑鼠标赋予这个词一个全新的日常动作。

items.en: The verb now also means to understand something suddenly.
items.cn: 这个动词如今还表示突然理解某事。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short sound words, while the meaning group names actions and noises of touching.
note.cn: 形近组收的是一批短小的拟声词，近义组列出触碰与声响类动作。

entries.definition: a short loud sound made by hard things hitting each other
entries.definitionCN: 硬物相撞发出的短促响声

entries.definition: a light ringing sound made by glass or metal
entries.definitionCN: 玻璃或金属相碰的清脆声

entries.definition: a small group of people who keep others out
to hit something lightly and quickly
to push something firmly with a finger or hand
the soft regular sound of a clock
entries.definitionCN: 钟表规律而轻柔的声响

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the snap of a latch, the mouse button and the moment an idea falls into place.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从门闩的脆响、鼠标按键和想法突然归位入手。

normal.en: Say the word aloud once and you have already made the sound it names.
normal.cn: 把这个词大声念一遍，你其实已经发出了它所命名的声音。

normal.en: The word is one syllable, as short as the noise itself.
normal.cn: 这个词只有一个音节，短得就像那声脆响。

normal.en: A latch clicks, a switch clicks, a mouse button clicks.
normal.cn: 门闩会咔一声，开关会咔一声，鼠标键也会咔一声。

normal.en: When an idea clicks, it locks into place like a latch.
normal.cn: 当想法一下子通了，它就像门闩一样扣进位置。

normal.en: Double-click puts two snaps together, so the ending joins with a hyphen.
normal.cn: double-click 把两次脆响并在一起，中间用连字符相连。

abstract.en: Picture a dark hallway and a latch snapping shut behind you.
abstract.cn: 想象一条昏暗的走廊，身后的门闩咔一声扣上。

abstract.en: Picture a finger resting on a mouse, one soft snap, then a page appears.
abstract.cn: 想象手指搭在鼠标上，轻轻一响，页面就出现了。

abstract.en: Picture a student who frowns, then smiles as the rule locks into place.
abstract.cn: 想象一个学生先皱眉，随后规则归位，他笑了。

examples.en: Click the link and the page will open in a new window.
examples.cn: 点击这个链接，页面会在新窗口打开。

examples.en: She heard the click of the latch and knew he was home.
examples.cn: 她听到门闩的咔嗒声，就知道他回来了。

examples.en: The rule finally clicked when the teacher drew a diagram.
examples.cn: 老师画了一张图，那条规则才终于让她明白了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 click 记成鼠标那一下脆响：手指一按，屏幕立刻回应。

root: 拟声词，模仿锁扣、开关合拢时的短促声响，二十世纪后用来指鼠标按键。

sensesIntro.en: From a small sound to a mouse action, and then to a mind that suddenly understands.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一声轻响，到鼠标动作，再到头脑突然明白。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger on a mouse button, one soft snap.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指按住鼠标键，发出轻轻一声脆响。

branches.en: A mouse button press borrows the name of its own sound.
branches.cn: 鼠标按键的动作借用了自己发出的声音之名。

branches.en: Locks, switches and heels all make this short snap.
branches.cn: 锁、开关和鞋跟都会发出这种短促的声响。

branches.en: A thought snaps into place like a latch closing.
branches.cn: 一个念头像门闩合上那样咔一下归位。

branches.en: One word covers the sound and the action that produces it.
branches.cn: 同一个词既指声音，也指发出声音的动作。

branches.en: The sharp snap became a picture for sudden understanding.
branches.cn: 清脆的一响成了突然领悟的形象说法。

intro.en: The word is too short to take prefixes, so its family grows by compounding and by common endings.
intro.cn: 这个词太短，无法再加前缀，家族靠复合与常见词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root here; the base itself imitates a sound.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根，词基本身就是拟声。

items.meaning: presses a mouse button or makes a small sound
items.example: He clicks the same icon every morning.
items.exampleCN: 他每天早上都点同一个图标。

items.meaning: pressed a button or made a small sound
items.example: She clicked the wrong link by mistake.
items.exampleCN: 她不小心点错了链接。

items.meaning: the act or repeated sound of a click
items.meaningCN: 点击的动作；连续的轻响
items.example: The clicking of the keyboard filled the room.
items.exampleCN: 键盘的咔嗒声充满了房间。

items.meaning: able to be clicked with a mouse
items.example: Every button on the page is clickable.
items.exampleCN: 页面上的每个按钮都可以点击。

items.meaning: a small device used to change channels
items.example: She changed the channel with a clicker.
items.exampleCN: 她用遥控器换了频道。

items.meaning: to press a mouse button twice quickly
items.example: Double-click the folder to open it.
items.exampleCN: 双击这个文件夹把它打开。

items.meaning: to press the right button of a mouse
items.example: Right-click the file and choose copy.
items.exampleCN: 右键点击该文件并选择复制。

items.example: The shop offers one-click payment.
items.exampleCN: 这家店提供一键付款。

items.meaning: a title written only to attract clicks
items.example: That headline is pure clickbait.
items.exampleCN: 那个标题纯粹是在骗点击。

definition_zh: 客户；委托人；客户端
definition_en: a person or company that pays for goods or services, a person who uses a professional service, or a computer that requests data from a server
core_image: 会客室里等着谈生意的那位老主顾
scene: 律师事务所的沙发上坐着一位等了很久的先生。The lawyer met her client at nine in the morning.
sceneCN: 这里 client 指「委托人」（第 2 个义项：接受专业人士服务的人）；句意是律师早上九点会见了她的委托人。

senses.title: A paying customer
senses.definition: a person or company that buys goods or services from a business
senses.definitionCN: 向商家购买商品或服务的个人或公司
senses.example: The firm lost its biggest client last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司去年失去了最大的客户。
senses.why: A client is someone who leans on a business for what he needs, so the word suits a steady business relationship.
senses.whyCN: 客户是依靠商家获得所需之物的人，所以这个词适合表示稳定的商业关系。

senses.title: A user of professional services
senses.definition: a person who pays a lawyer, designer or other professional for advice or work
senses.definitionCN: 付钱请律师、设计师等专业人士提供意见或工作的人
senses.example: The architect showed the client three designs.
senses.exampleCN: 建筑师给委托人看了三份设计。
senses.why: Professionals serve one named person rather than a crowd, and that person is called a client.
senses.whyCN: 专业人士服务的是一位具名的人而不是人群，这个人就叫委托人。

senses.title: A computer that requests data
senses.definition: a computer or program that asks a server for data or services
senses.definitionCN: 向服务器请求数据或服务的计算机或程序
senses.example: The client sends a request and waits for the reply.
senses.exampleCN: 客户端发出请求，然后等待回复。
senses.why: Computing borrowed the word because the small machine also depends on a larger provider.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域借用这个词，因为小机器同样依赖更大的服务方。

intro.en: Client comes from a Latin verb meaning to lean, not from any word for money.
intro.cn: client 出自拉丁语中表示倚靠的动词，与金钱毫无关系。

items.en: The family of clinare described leaning or bending.
items.cn: clinare 这一词族表示倾斜或倚靠。

items.en: Cliens named a follower who leaned on a patron for protection.
items.cn: cliens 指依靠庇护者保护的随从。

items.en: The word passed through French into legal language.
items.cn: 这个词经法语进入法律用语。

items.en: Client first meant a person under another man's protection.
items.cn: client 最初指受他人保护的人。

items.en: Commerce widened it to any paying customer, and computing added the client machine.
items.cn: 商业把它扩展为任何付钱的顾客，计算机又添上客户端之义。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words that echo the spelling of client, while the meaning group names people who buy or use services.
note.cn: 形近组收的是拼写与 client 相近的词，近义组列出购买或使用服务的人。

entries.definition: a place where people go for medical advice or treatment
entries.definitionCN: 人们去看病或咨询的诊所

entries.definition: all the clients of a business or a professional person
entries.definitionCN: 一家企业或一位专业人士的全部客户

entries.definition: to hold on to something tightly
a person who buys goods or services from a shop
entries.definitionCN: 在商店购买商品或服务的人

entries.definition: a person who buys and uses goods and services
entries.definitionCN: 购买并使用商品和服务的人

entries.definition: a person who regularly uses a shop, hotel or theatre
entries.definitionCN: 经常光顾某商店、旅馆或剧院的人

normalIntro.en: These hooks work from the leaning root, the waiting room and the difference between a client and a customer.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从倚靠词根、会客室以及客户与顾客的区别入手。

normal.en: Client and customer both buy, but a client usually buys advice or a service.
normal.cn: client 与 customer 都买东西，但 client 通常买的是建议或服务。

normal.en: The Latin cliens was a follower who leaned on a patron.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 cliens 是依靠庇护者的随从。

normal.en: A lawyer has clients, while a supermarket has customers.
normal.cn: 律师有委托人，超市有顾客。

normal.en: The noun clientele keeps the same stem and means the whole group of clients.
normal.cn: 名词 clientele 词干相同，指全部客户。

normal.en: In computing the client asks and the server answers.
normal.cn: 在计算机里，客户端发问，服务器作答。

abstract.en: Picture a man in a coat waiting on a leather sofa with a folder on his knee.
abstract.cn: 想象一位穿外套的先生坐在皮沙发上，膝上放着文件夹。

abstract.en: Picture two hands, one leaning on the other for support.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手，一只手倚着另一只手支撑自己。

abstract.en: Picture a small laptop asking a huge grey server for a file.
abstract.cn: 想象一台小笔记本向巨大的灰色服务器索取文件。

examples.en: The designer sent the client a revised plan.
examples.cn: 设计师把修改后的方案发给了委托人。

examples.en: This bank treats every client as a long-term partner.
examples.cn: 这家银行把每位客户都当作长期伙伴。

examples.en: The client software updates itself once a week.
examples.cn: 客户端软件每周自动更新一次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 client 想成「倚靠」你的人：他倚赖你的服务，你倚赖他的订单。

root: 源自拉丁语 cliens（依附者），出自表示倾斜、倚靠的词族，本义是依靠庇护者的人。

sensesIntro.en: From a dependent follower to a paying customer, then to the machine that asks a server.
sensesIntro.cn: 从依附的随从，到付钱的客户，再到向服务器发请求的机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person leaning on a stronger partner for support.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人倚靠着更强的一方获取支撑。

branches.en: A steady buyer leans on a business, and the business keeps him.
branches.cn: 稳定的买家倚赖商家，商家也留住他。

branches.en: Professional work creates a named person who pays for advice.
branches.cn: 专业工作产生了一位为意见付费的具名之人。

branches.en: Software copies the pattern: the small side asks, the big side answers.
branches.cn: 软件复制了这个模式：小的一方发问，大的一方作答。

branches.en: Both senses keep one idea, a person served rather than a crowd.
branches.cn: 两个义项共有一个意思：被服务的是个人而非人群。

branches.en: Both use the word for the dependent side of a relationship.
branches.cn: 两者都用这个词指关系中的依赖方。

intro.en: The stem client carries the family, and most relatives simply add a suffix or join another word.
intro.cn: 词干 client 撑起整个家族，多数亲属词只是加后缀或与另一词复合。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin cliens, the dependent follower who leaned on a patron.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 cliens，即倚靠庇护者的依附者。

items.meaning: more than one customer or dependent person
items.example: The studio serves clients in three cities.
items.exampleCN: 这家工作室为三个城市的客户服务。

items.meaning: the whole group of clients of a business
items.example: The cafe has a young clientele.
items.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆的顾客以年轻人为主。

items.example: The new office opened clientless but hopeful.
items.exampleCN: 新办公室开业时没有客户，却满怀希望。

items.meaning: using one machine to ask and another to answer
items.example: The system follows a client-server model.
items.exampleCN: 该系统采用客户服务器模式。

items.meaning: all the customers a business can rely on
items.example: The merger doubled the client base.
items.exampleCN: 合并使客户基础扩大了一倍。

items.example: She moved into a client-facing role.
items.exampleCN: 她转到了一线面对客户的岗位。

items.example: The team keeps a client-focused habit.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队保持着以客户为中心的习惯。

items.meaning: the state of being a client
items.example: Clientship brings regular reports.
items.exampleCN: 客户身份带来定期的报告。

latinEntries.meaning: a follower who depends on a patron
latinEntries.example: Cliens gave English the word client.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cliens 给英语带来了 client 一词。

latinEntries.example: Clinare stands behind the image of leaning.
latinEntries.exampleCN: clinare 是「倚靠」这一意象的来源。

definition_zh: 气候；氛围；形势
definition_en: the usual weather conditions of a place over a long period, or the general mood and conditions in a group or period
core_image: 同一片天空下年年重复的雨与晴
scene: 老人翻着几十年的农事笔记，记下每年第一场雨的日子。The mild climate here suits tea and oranges.
sceneCN: 这里 climate 指「气候」（第 1 个义项：一个地方长期的天气状况）；句意是这里温和的气候适合种茶和柑橘。

senses.title: Long-term weather of a place
senses.definition: the usual weather conditions of a region over many years
senses.definitionCN: 一个地区多年间反复出现的天气状况
senses.example: The island has a warm climate and little snow.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛气候温暖，很少下雪。
senses.why: Greek geographers divided the world into belts by the angle of the sun, and each belt became a climate.
senses.whyCN: 希腊地理学家按日照角度把世界分成带，每一条带就叫一个气候区。

senses.title: The mood of a group
senses.definition: the general feeling or attitude among a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 一群人当中普遍的情绪或态度
senses.example: A climate of trust made the talks easier.
senses.exampleCN: 信任的氛围让谈判顺利了许多。
senses.why: Weather surrounds people and shapes their day, and so does a shared mood, which borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 天气包围并影响人的一天，共同的氛围也是如此，于是借用了同一个词。

senses.title: Conditions affecting decisions
senses.definition: the economic or political conditions that affect how people act
senses.definitionCN: 影响人们行动方式的经济或政治条件
senses.example: Few firms hire in such a poor climate.
senses.exampleCN: 在如此糟糕的形势下，很少有公司招人。
senses.why: Business writers needed a word for the surrounding conditions, and the weather word was ready.
senses.whyCN: 商业作者需要一个词表示周围的条件，天气词正好现成可用。

intro.en: Climate began as a Greek word for a slope, because the sun's angle decides how warm a region is.
intro.cn: climate 最初是希腊语中表示斜坡的词，因为日照角度决定了一个地区的冷暖。

items.en: Klima meant a slope or a zone of the earth.
items.cn: klima 指斜坡或地球上的一条地带。

items.en: Geographers used it for bands of the world marked by sun and slope.
items.cn: 地理学家用它指按日照与坡度划分的地带。

items.en: Clima kept the sense of a zone of the earth.
items.cn: clima 保留了地球地带的意思。

items.en: The word entered French as climat.
items.cn: 这个词以 climat 的形式进入法语。

items.en: English first used it for a region and its weather.
items.cn: 英语最初用它指一个地区及其天气。

items.en: The word widened to the mood of a group and the state of business.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到群体氛围与商业形势。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in spelling, while the meaning group covers weather, surroundings and shared mood.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的词，近义组涵盖天气、环境与共同情绪。

entries.definition: to move upward using hands and feet
the most exciting or important point of a story
entries.definitionCN: 故事中最激动人心或最重要的时刻

entries.definition: an old poetic word for a region and its weather
entries.definitionCN: 古诗文中指某个地区及其天气

entries.definition: the condition of the air on a particular day
entries.definitionCN: 某一天空气的具体状况

entries.definition: the feeling that a place or event gives people
entries.definitionCN: 某个地方或事件给人的感觉

entries.definition: the conditions and surroundings in which people live
entries.definitionCN: 人们生活所处的条件与周围情况

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the sun's angle, the long record of weather and the mood of a meeting room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从日照角度、长期天气记录和会议室气氛入手。

normal.en: Climate and climb share a start: both look up at the sky.
normal.cn: climate 与 climb 开头相同：两者都抬头看天。

normal.en: Weather is today; climate is the average of many years.
normal.cn: weather 是今天，climate 是许多年的平均。

normal.en: The Greek klima meant a slope, because slope decides how much sun a place gets.
normal.cn: 希腊语 klima 意为斜坡，因为坡度决定一个地方得到多少阳光。

normal.en: The same word covers the room as well as the sky: a climate of trust.
normal.cn: 同一个词既能说天空，也能说房间：信任的氛围。

normal.en: Climatic keeps the adjective, climatology keeps the science.
normal.cn: climatic 是形容词，climatology 是这门学科。

abstract.en: Picture a globe marked with belts, hot at the middle and cold at the poles.
abstract.cn: 想象一个划成条带的地球，中间炎热，两极寒冷。

abstract.en: Picture a farmer's notebook full of rain dates across forty years.
abstract.cn: 想象一本农家笔记，记满四十年间的降雨日期。

abstract.en: Picture a quiet meeting room where everyone nods before speaking.
abstract.cn: 想象一间安静的会议室，人人发言前都先点头。

examples.en: The climate here is too dry for rice.
examples.cn: 这里的气候太干燥，不适合种稻。

examples.en: Climate change is reshaping the coast.
examples.cn: 气候变化正在改变海岸的面貌。

examples.en: The company expanded in a favourable economic climate.
examples.cn: 这家公司在有利的经济形势下扩张。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 climate 记成「斜坡上的天气」：坡向哪儿，阳光就怎么照，一方水土便有了脾气。

root: 源自希腊语 klima（斜坡、地带），经拉丁语 clima 与法语 climat 进入英语，本义是按日照划分的地带。

sensesIntro.en: From a band of the earth to the weather of a place, then to the mood around people and the state of trade.
sensesIntro.cn: 从地球上的地带，到一个地方的天气，再到人群氛围与商业形势。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slope of land under a particular angle of sun.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片土地在特定日照角度下形成的斜坡。

branches.en: The physical sense is the long weather record of one region.
branches.cn: 实义是一个地区长期的天气记录。

branches.en: A shared feeling wraps a group the way weather wraps a town.
branches.cn: 共同的感受笼罩一个群体，就像天气笼罩一座城。

branches.en: Economic conditions become a climate that firms must read.
branches.cn: 经济条件成了一种企业必须判读的气候。

branches.en: Both senses describe surroundings that people cannot easily change.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述人们不易改变的环境。

branches.en: Mood and market conditions are both the air a decision is made in.
branches.cn: 氛围与市场条件都是做决定时所处的空气。

intro.en: The stem climat carries the family, with adjective, adverb and scientific endings added.
intro.cn: 词干 climat 撑起家族，再添加形容词、副词与学科词尾。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek klima, a slope, which Latin took over as clima.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是希腊语 klima（斜坡），拉丁语把它接收为 clima。

items.meaning: more than one pattern of regional weather
items.example: The book compares climates on three continents.
items.exampleCN: 这本书比较了三大洲的气候。

items.example: Climatic zones shift as the earth warms.
items.exampleCN: 随着地球变暖，气候带发生移动。

items.example: The two ports are climatically similar.
items.exampleCN: 这两个港口在气候上相似。

items.example: She studied climatology for six years.
items.exampleCN: 她学了六年气候学。

items.example: A climatologist explained the rainfall data.
items.exampleCN: 一位气候学家解释了降雨数据。

items.meaning: the climate of one small area
items.example: The valley has its own microclimate.
items.exampleCN: 这条山谷有自己的小气候。

items.meaning: not harmful to the global climate
items.example: They chose climate-friendly heating.
items.exampleCN: 他们选择了对气候友好的供暖方式。

items.meaning: a long-term shift in global weather patterns
items.example: Climate change is a global issue.
items.exampleCN: 气候变化是一个全球性问题。

latinEntries.meaning: a zone or belt of the earth
latinEntries.example: Clima passed into French and then English.

definition_zh: 攀登；爬；上升
definition_en: to move upward using your hands and feet, to rise in amount or level, or an act of going up
core_image: 双手抓住岩缝一点点向上挪动
scene: 天还没亮，队伍已经在山脚系好鞋带。They plan to climb the north face before noon.
sceneCN: 这里 climb 指「攀登」（第 1 个义项：手脚并用向上移动）；句意是他们打算中午前攀上北壁。

senses.title: Go up with hands and feet
senses.definition: to move upward on a steep surface using your hands and feet
senses.definitionCN: 在陡峭的表面上手脚并用向上移动
senses.example: The children climbed the old oak tree.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们爬上了那棵老橡树。
senses.why: The old verb described effort against gravity, so it keeps the picture of hands and feet.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的动词描述对抗重力的用力，因此保留着手脚并用的画面。

senses.title: Rise in amount or level
senses.definition: to increase gradually in number, price or temperature
senses.definitionCN: 在数量、价格或温度上逐步升高
senses.example: Fuel prices climbed again last month.
senses.exampleCN: 上个月燃料价格又上涨了。
senses.why: A rising line on a chart looks like a slope being climbed, so the verb moved to figures.
senses.whyCN: 图表上上扬的线像在爬坡，这个动词便迁移到了数字上。

senses.title: An upward journey
senses.definition: a journey or movement upward, often a long or hard one
senses.definitionCN: 向上的行程或移动，往往漫长而费力
senses.example: The last climb to the summit took four hours.
senses.exampleCN: 登顶的最后一段爬升花了四个小时。
senses.why: English often turns a verb into a noun, and the action then becomes a countable trip.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把动词用作名词，动作便成了一次可数的行程。

intro.en: Climb is an Old English verb for going up with effort, and its silent b is a spelling habit.
intro.cn: climb 是表示费力向上的古英语动词，其中不发音的 b 是拼写习惯留下的。

items.en: Climban meant to go up with effort, usually with hands and feet.
items.cn: climban 指费力向上，通常手脚并用。

items.en: Related verbs in German and Dutch named the same effort.
items.cn: 德语和荷兰语中的相关动词表示同样的用力。

items.en: The final b often dropped out of ordinary speech.
items.cn: 在日常口语中，词尾的 b 常常脱落。

items.en: Writers restored the b, which has been silent ever since.
items.cn: 文人恢复了字母 b，此后它一直不发音。

items.en: Prices and numbers climb too, so no ladder is needed.
items.cn: 价格和数字也会 climb，所以不再需要梯子。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that echo the shape of climb, while the meaning group names ways of going up.
note.cn: 形近组收与 climb 形近的词，近义组列出向上行进的说法。

entries.definition: an old poetic word for a region and its weather
entries.definitionCN: 古诗文中指地区及其天气

entries.definition: the most intense point of a story or event
entries.definitionCN: 故事或事件中最紧张的时刻

entries.definition: a person who climbs, or a plant that climbs
entries.definitionCN: 攀登者，或会攀爬的植物

entries.definition: to go up along a slope or a stair
to get on a horse or to go up something
to climb a wall or a high rock with effort
entries.definitionCN: 费力地攀登墙壁或高岩

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the silent letter, the mountain path and the rising price line.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从不发音的字母、山道和上扬的价格线入手。

normal.en: The b in climb is silent, so say the word as if it were clime.
normal.cn: climb 里的 b 不发音，读起来就像 clime。

normal.en: Climb keeps the same shape as limb, and you climb with your limbs.
normal.cn: climb 与 limb 形状相近，而人正是用四肢攀登。

normal.en: A climb is up, never down, so the word always points to the summit.
normal.cn: climb 只向上不向下，所以这个词永远指向山顶。

normal.en: The climber adds -er, and the climbing adds -ing.
normal.cn: climber 加 -er 指人，climbing 加 -ing 指这项运动。

normal.en: Prices climb, hopes climb, and the temperature climbs in July.
normal.cn: 价格会爬升，希望会攀升，七月的温度也会上升。

abstract.en: Picture two dusty hands finding a crack in the rock.
abstract.cn: 想象两只沾满灰尘的手在岩壁上摸到一道裂缝。

abstract.en: Picture a line of climbers on a ridge before sunrise.
abstract.cn: 想象日出前山脊上一串登山者的身影。

abstract.en: Picture a price line on a screen going up step by step.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上一条价格线一步一步往上走。

examples.en: We climbed for six hours before reaching the ridge.
examples.cn: 我们爬了六个小时才到达山脊。

examples.en: The cat climbed onto the roof and would not come down.
examples.cn: 那只猫爬上屋顶，怎么也不肯下来。

examples.en: Rents have climbed faster than wages in this city.
examples.cn: 在这座城市，房租涨得比工资快。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 climb 想成「用四肢（limb）向上」：手抓脚蹬，一寸一寸往上挪。

root: 源自古英语 climban（费力向上），属日耳曼语族，本义是手脚并用地攀援。

sensesIntro.en: From hands on rock to a rising price, then back to the journey itself as a noun.
sensesIntro.cn: 从手抓岩石，到价格上涨，再回到作为名词的这段行程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands and feet pulling a body up a steep face.
core.cn: 核心意象：手脚把身体拉上一面陡坡。

branches.en: The physical sense keeps the old picture of effort and grip.
branches.cn: 实义保留了用力与抓握的古老画面。

branches.en: A rising figure on a chart is a slope to be climbed.
branches.cn: 图表上上升的数字就是一段待爬的坡。

branches.en: The trip itself becomes a countable noun with a beginning and an end.
branches.cn: 这段路程本身成了有始有终的可数名词。

branches.en: The verb and the noun describe the same upward movement.
branches.cn: 动词与名词描述的是同一种向上运动。

branches.en: Both use the idea of steady upward progress.
branches.cn: 两者都借助稳步向上的进程这一意象。

intro.en: The base verb grows a noun for the person, a noun for the sport and a few compounds.
intro.cn: 这个动词长出指人的名词、指运动的名词以及若干复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English verb climban.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语动词 climban。

items.meaning: goes up using hands and feet
items.example: She climbs the same hill every Sunday.
items.exampleCN: 她每个星期天都爬同一座小山。

items.example: They climbed the tower before dusk.
items.exampleCN: 他们在黄昏前爬上了那座塔。

items.meaning: the activity of going up rocks or mountains
items.example: Climbing demands strong fingers and calm nerves.
items.exampleCN: 攀岩需要有力的手指和镇定的神经。

items.meaning: a person or plant that climbs
items.example: The climber paused below the overhang.
items.exampleCN: 攀登者在岩檐下方停了一下。

items.example: The wall is low and easily climbable.
items.exampleCN: 那堵墙很低，容易爬上去。

items.meaning: the sport of climbing rock faces
items.example: Rock climbing is popular in this valley.
items.exampleCN: 攀岩在这条山谷很流行。

items.meaning: the activity of climbing high mountains
items.example: Mountain climbing takes weeks of planning.
items.exampleCN: 登山需要数周的准备。

items.meaning: to admit that you were wrong
items.example: The minister had to climb down over the plan.
items.exampleCN: 部长不得不就这项计划让步。

definition_zh: 时钟；记录（时间或速度）；（车辆的）里程表
definition_en: an instrument that shows the time, or to measure and record a time, speed or distance
core_image: 墙上那只滴答走动的圆盘钟
scene: 厨房的墙上挂着一只旧钟，秒针每走一步都轻响一下。The clock in the hall is ten minutes fast.
sceneCN: 这里 clock 指「时钟」（第 1 个义项：显示时间的器具）；句意是门厅那只钟快了十分钟。

pos.zh: 记录（时间、速度）；达到（某速度）

senses.title: An instrument showing time
senses.definition: a device with a face or a display that shows the time
senses.definitionCN: 带有表盘或显示屏、用来显示时间的器具
senses.example: The kitchen clock stopped during the night.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房的钟在夜里停了。
senses.why: The first clocks were bells that rang the hour, so the machine took the name of the bell.
senses.whyCN: 最早的钟是会报时的铃，于是这台机器承用了铃的名字。

senses.title: Record a time or speed
senses.definition: to measure and record how long something takes or how fast it goes
senses.definitionCN: 测量并记下某事花的时间或达到的速度
senses.example: Officials clocked the runner at under ten seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 裁判记下那名跑者用时不到十秒。
senses.why: A clock measures time, so the verb simply means using one to record a result.
senses.whyCN: 钟表用来量时间，动词自然就是用它记下一个结果。

senses.title: A meter in a vehicle
senses.definition: the instrument in a car that records distance travelled
senses.definitionCN: 汽车上记录行驶距离的仪表
senses.example: The van has ninety thousand miles on the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆货车的里程表显示已跑九万英里。
senses.why: Any dial that counts becomes a clock in everyday speech, especially in a car.
senses.whyCN: 任何会计数的表盘在日常口语里都能叫 clock，尤其用于汽车。

intro.en: Clock began as a word for a bell, not for a machine with hands.
intro.cn: clock 最初指钟铃，而不是带指针的机器。

items.en: Clocca meant a bell, probably taken from an older Celtic word.
items.cn: clocca 指钟铃，可能借自更早的凯尔特语。

items.en: Clocke named a bell that struck the hours.
items.cn: clocke 指按小时敲响的钟。

items.en: English borrowed the word for the new tower machines.
items.cn: 英语借来这个词，指新的塔楼机械钟。

items.en: The face and hands became the usual meaning.
items.cn: 表盘与指针成为这个词的通常含义。

items.en: The verb now means to time a run or to reach a speed.
items.cn: 动词义如今指给跑步计时或达到某个速度。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words close in shape, while the meaning group names timekeeping devices.
note.cn: 形近组收形状相近的短词，近义组列出计时器具。

entries.definition: a loose outer garment without sleeves
to make the low sound of a hen
a solid piece of stone, wood or other material
entries.definitionCN: 石头、木头等材料的实心块

entries.definition: a small clock worn on the wrist
a device that counts down or records time
entries.definitionCN: 倒计时或记录时间的装置

entries.definition: a person or device that records time

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the bell inside the word, the round face and the habit of counting hours.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从词里的钟铃、圆表盘和数小时的习惯入手。

normal.en: Clock once meant a bell, and a bell is still what strikes the hour.
normal.cn: clock 曾经指铃，而报时的至今仍是铃。

normal.en: Add -wise and you get clockwise, the way the hands travel.
normal.cn: 加上 -wise 就是顺时针，也就是指针走的方向。

normal.en: Clockwork keeps the old image of wheels and springs.
normal.cn: clockwork 保留了齿轮与发条的老画面。

normal.en: Around the clock means all day and all night, like a clock that never stops.
normal.cn: around the clock 指昼夜不停，就像一只从不停的钟。

normal.en: To clock a runner is to let the clock do the judging.
normal.cn: 给跑者 clock，就是让钟表来当裁判。

abstract.en: Picture a round face with two thin hands crossing above the twelve.
abstract.cn: 想象一张圆表盘，两根细指针在十二点上方交叉。

abstract.en: Picture a tower bell swinging and the whole square looking up.
abstract.cn: 想象塔上的钟摆动着，整个广场的人都抬头看。

abstract.en: Picture a factory gate where workers clock in at dawn.
abstract.cn: 想象工厂大门，工人在天亮时打卡上班。

examples.en: Set the clock forward when the new term begins.
examples.cn: 新学期开始时把钟往前拨。

examples.en: The nurses worked around the clock during the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨期间护士们昼夜不停地工作。

examples.en: He clocked the lap at fifty-eight seconds.
examples.cn: 他记下这一圈用时五十八秒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 clock 记成「会叫的圆盘」：到点就敲，一圈十二格，把一天切成小段。

root: 源自中世纪拉丁语 clocca（钟铃），经荷兰语 clocke 进入英语，本义是会报时的钟。

sensesIntro.en: From a bell that strikes the hour to the machine on the wall, then to the act of timing something.
sensesIntro.cn: 从报时的钟铃，到墙上的机器，再到给某事计时的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round face whose hands divide the day.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张圆表盘，指针把一天分开。

branches.en: The everyday sense is the machine that tells the time.
branches.cn: 日常义就是那台报时的机器。

branches.en: Using the machine to measure a run turns the noun into a verb.
branches.cn: 用这台机器测量跑步，就把名词变成了动词。

branches.en: Any counting dial in a car borrows the name of the clock.
branches.cn: 车上任何计数表盘都借用了钟的名字。

branches.en: The device and the act of reading it share one stem.
branches.cn: 器具与读数的动作共用一个词干。

branches.en: Both are dials that count something regularly.
branches.cn: 两者都是规律计数的表盘。

intro.en: The word forms compounds easily, and a few endings give adverbs and abstract nouns.
intro.cn: 这个词很容易构成复合词，少量词尾造出副词与抽象名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Medieval Latin clocca, a bell, which reached English through Dutch.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是中世纪拉丁语 clocca（钟铃），经荷兰语进入英语。

items.example: The shop repairs clocks of every size.
items.exampleCN: 这家店修理各种尺寸的钟。

items.meaning: recorded a time or reached a speed
items.meaningCN: 记录了时间；达到了某速度
items.example: The car clocked 120 miles an hour.
items.exampleCN: 这辆车跑到了每小时一百二十英里。

items.example: Clocking the race took two officials.
items.exampleCN: 为比赛计时需要两名裁判。

items.meaning: in the direction the hands turn
items.example: Turn the lid clockwise to close it.
items.exampleCN: 顺时针转动盖子把它拧紧。

items.meaning: machinery driven by springs and wheels
items.example: The old toy runs on clockwork.
items.exampleCN: 这个旧玩具靠发条驱动。

items.example: The clocker stood at the finish line.
items.exampleCN: 计时员站在终点线旁。

items.meaning: a clock that rings to wake you
items.example: My alarm clock rings at six.
items.exampleCN: 我的闹钟六点响。

items.meaning: the front of a clock marked with numbers
items.example: The clock face is cracked but still readable.
items.exampleCN: 钟面裂了，但仍看得清。

latinEntries.example: Clocca travelled north into Dutch and English.
latinEntries.exampleCN: clocca 向北传入荷兰语和英语。

definition_zh: 关闭；结束；近的；亲密的
definition_en: to shut something or bring it to an end, or near in space, time or relationship
core_image: 一只手把门轻轻带上的那一下
scene: 客厅里灯还亮着，走廊尽头传来门轴的轻响。Please close the window before you leave.
sceneCN: 这里 close 指「关上」（第 1 个义项：使某物关闭）；句意是离开前请把窗户关上。

senses.title: Shut something
senses.definition: to move a door, lid or window so that it is no longer open
senses.definitionCN: 把门、盖子或窗移回不敞开的状态
senses.example: She closed the gate and locked it.
senses.exampleCN: 她关上院门并上了锁。
senses.why: The Latin base meant to shut, so this is the oldest and most physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词基本义就是关闭，因此这是最古老也最具体的义项。

senses.title: Bring to an end
senses.definition: to finish an activity, a meeting or a business deal
senses.definitionCN: 结束一项活动、一次会议或一笔生意
senses.example: The chairman closed the meeting at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 主席在中午结束了会议。
senses.why: A meeting that is finished is like a door that is shut, so the same verb serves both.
senses.whyCN: 会议结束就像门被合上，于是同一个动词两处通用。

senses.title: Near or intimate
senses.definition: very near in space or time, or strongly connected by feeling
senses.definitionCN: 在空间或时间上很近，或因感情而紧密相连
senses.example: They have been close friends since school.
senses.exampleCN: 他们从学生时代起就是好朋友。
senses.why: The adjective came from the idea of an enclosed space, where things are packed tightly together.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词出自围合空间的概念，其中的东西被紧紧收在一起。

intro.en: Close comes from a Latin verb for shutting, and the near sense grew from the idea of an enclosed space.
intro.cn: close 出自拉丁语表示关闭的动词，而「近」的意思由围合空间的概念生长出来。

items.en: Claudere meant to shut or to block an opening.
items.cn: claudere 指关闭或堵住开口。

items.en: The participle clausum described something already shut.
items.cn: 分词 clausum 描述已经关上的事物。

items.en: Clos meant enclosed and gave the adjective its near sense.
items.cn: clos 意为围起来的，给了形容词「近」的含义。

items.en: English took close as a verb meaning to shut.
items.cn: 英语把 close 用作动词，表示关闭。

items.en: The adjective close named things tightly packed or near.
items.cn: 形容词 close 指塞得紧或距离近的事物。

items.en: The two pronunciation patterns still keep the verb and the adjective apart.
items.cn: 两套读音至今仍把动词和形容词区分开来。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that differ from close by a sound or a letter, while the meaning group names shutting and nearness.
note.cn: 形近组收与 close 差一个音或一个字母的词，近义组列出关闭与接近。

entries.definition: a test in which words are removed from a text
entries.definitionCN: 从文章中挖去若干词项的填空测试

entries.definition: a cupboard built for hanging clothes
a group of words with its own subject and verb
entries.definitionCN: 含主语和谓语的一组词

entries.definition: to move something so that it blocks an opening
entries.definitionCN: 把某物移到位以堵住开口

entries.definition: a short distance away in space or time
entries.definitionCN: 在空间或时间上距离很短

entries.definition: very private and personal, or very close to someone
entries.definitionCN: 极为私密的，或与某人非常亲近的

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two sounds of the word, the shutting door and the friend who stands near.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两种读音、合上的门和近旁的朋友入手。

normal.en: The verb ends with a buzzing z, the adjective ends with a hissing s.
normal.cn: 动词结尾是浊音 z，形容词结尾是清音 s。

normal.en: Claustrophobia keeps the same Latin base and means fear of enclosed space.
normal.cn: claustrophobia 同出一个拉丁词基，意为害怕封闭空间。

normal.en: Close a door, close a meeting, close a deal: all three end something.
normal.cn: 关门、闭会、成交，三者都是让某事收尾。

normal.en: A close friend is not far away in feeling.
normal.cn: close friend 指的是感情上不疏远。

normal.en: Add -ly and close becomes the adverb closely.
normal.cn: 加上 -ly，close 就变成副词 closely。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on a door, pushing it until the latch catches.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手推门，直到门闩扣上。

abstract.en: Picture two chairs pulled so near that the armrests touch.
abstract.cn: 想象两把椅子拉得很近，扶手都碰到了。

abstract.en: Picture a folder snapped shut at the end of a long meeting.
abstract.cn: 想象一场长会结束时文件夹被合上。

examples.en: Close the gate when you leave the yard.
examples.cn: 离开院子时把大门关上。

examples.en: The shop closes at nine on weekdays.
examples.cn: 这家店工作日九点关门。

examples.en: She lives close to the station and walks to work.
examples.cn: 她住得离车站很近，步行上班。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 close 想成两扇门向中间合拢：合上就是关闭，合得紧就是亲近。

root: 源自拉丁语 claudere（关闭），经法语 clos 进入英语，同时发展出「关闭」与「围合而近」两条线。

sensesIntro.en: From shutting a door to finishing an event, and then to the nearness of people and things.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把门关上，到把活动结束，再到人与物的接近。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pulling a door until it meets the frame.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手拉门，直到门贴上门框。

branches.en: The physical act of shutting comes straight from the Latin verb.
branches.cn: 关闭的实体动作直接来自拉丁动词。

branches.en: Finishing a meeting is shutting it in a figurative way.
branches.cn: 结束会议是以比喻方式把它关上。

branches.en: Things inside an enclosure sit near each other, and people can be near in feeling.
branches.cn: 围合空间里的东西彼此靠近，人与人也能在感情上靠近。

branches.en: Both senses mark the end of an open state.
branches.cn: 两个义项都标记某种敞开状态的终结。

branches.en: A closed circle of friends is both finished to outsiders and intimate inside.
branches.cn: 封闭的朋友圈子对外结束，对内亲密。

intro.en: The Latin base produces a large family, with prefixes that add direction and endings that add grammar.
intro.cn: 这个拉丁词基衍生出庞大的家族，前缀添方向，词尾添语法。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin claudere, to shut, whose participle clausum means shut.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 claudere（关闭），其分词 clausum 意为已关上的。

items.meaning: shuts something or finishes an event
items.example: The library closes at six on Fridays.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆周五六点关门。

items.meaning: shut or not open to the public
items.example: The road is closed after the landslide.
items.exampleCN: 塌方之后这条路封闭了。

items.meaning: the final part of an event
items.example: His closing words were short and warm.
items.exampleCN: 他的结束语简短而温暖。

items.meaning: the act of shutting a place for good
items.example: The closure of the mill cost many jobs.
items.exampleCN: 工厂关闭让许多人失去工作。

items.example: The second shop is closer to the bus stop.
items.exampleCN: 第二家店离公交站更近。

items.example: Choose the closest date that suits you.
items.exampleCN: 选一个对你最合适的最近日期。

items.meaning: to surround something with a wall or fence
items.example: They enclosed the garden with a low wall.
items.exampleCN: 他们用矮墙把花园围了起来。

items.example: The firm must disclose its accounts.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司必须公开账目。

items.meaning: an area surrounded by a barrier
items.example: The sheep were kept in a small enclosure.
items.exampleCN: 羊被关在一个小围场里。

latinEntries.example: Claudere gave English close and closure.
latinEntries.exampleCN: claudere 给英语带来了 close 与 closure。

latinEntries.example: Clausum passed into French as clos.
latinEntries.exampleCN: clausum 进入法语后写作 clos。

definition_zh: 仔细地；密切地；紧密地
definition_en: in a careful and attentive way, or in a way that is very near or tightly connected
core_image: 放大镜几乎贴到纸面上
scene: 实验室里两个人并肩盯着同一块切片。The two teams worked closely on the design.
sceneCN: 这里 closely 指「密切地」（第 2 个义项：紧密相连地）；句意是两支团队在设计上密切合作。

senses.title: With careful attention
senses.definition: with great attention to detail, so that nothing is missed
senses.definitionCN: 非常注意细节，不遗漏任何东西
senses.example: The doctor looked closely at the small scar.
senses.exampleCN: 医生仔细察看那道小疤痕。
senses.why: To look close means to bring your eyes near, and near looking means careful looking.
senses.whyCN: look close 是把眼睛凑近，凑近了看自然是仔细地看。

senses.title: In a tightly connected way
senses.definition: in a way that is very near or strongly linked
senses.definitionCN: 以非常接近或联系很强的方式
senses.example: The two industries are closely linked.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个行业紧密相连。
senses.why: The adverb simply carries the near sense of the adjective into verbs and participles.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词只是把形容词的「近」义带入动词和分词。

intro.en: Closely is the adjective close plus the old adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: closely 就是形容词 close 加上古老的副词词尾 -ly。

items.en: Claudere meant to shut, and its participle meant shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭，其分词意为已关上的。

items.en: Clos meant enclosed and described things packed near.
items.cn: clos 意为围起来的，形容靠得很近的事物。

items.en: The adjective close entered English with the near sense.
items.cn: 形容词 close 带着「近」的含义进入英语。

items.en: The ending -ly turned the adjective into an adverb of manner.
items.cn: 词尾 -ly 把形容词变为方式副词。

items.en: Closely now covers careful attention as well as physical nearness.
items.cn: closely 如今既指细心关注，也指空间接近。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the adjective and nouns built on the same stem, while the meaning group names careful and tight ways of acting.
note.cn: 形近组收同一词干上的形容词与名词，近义组列出仔细与紧密的行事方式。

entries.definition: near in space, time or feeling
entries.definitionCN: 在空间、时间或感情上接近的

entries.definition: the state of being near or intimate
the shutting of a place or a feeling of ending
entries.definitionCN: 场所关闭，或事情了结的感觉

entries.definition: with attention and caution
with strong and fixed attention
entries.definitionCN: 以强烈而专注的注意力

entries.definition: in a firm and secure way

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the adjective behind the adverb, the magnifying glass and the linked chains.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从副词背后的形容词、放大镜和相扣的链条入手。

normal.en: Take the adjective close, add -ly, and the adverb is ready.
normal.cn: 拿形容词 close 加 -ly，副词就成了。

normal.en: Closely related is a fixed pair that appears in almost every academic text.
normal.cn: closely related 是固定搭配，几乎每篇学术文章都能见到。

normal.en: Look closely means bring your face near the page.
normal.cn: look closely 就是把脸凑近纸面。

normal.en: Work closely means the desks are near and the talk is constant.
normal.cn: work closely 意味着桌子挨得近，交流不断。

normal.en: The adverb never changes form, so no plural or tense is needed.
normal.cn: 这个副词从不改变形式，不需要复数或时态。

abstract.en: Picture a magnifying glass almost touching the print.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚放大镜几乎贴到字面上。

abstract.en: Picture two workers leaning over the same drawing.
abstract.cn: 想象两名工人俯身看同一张图纸。

abstract.en: Picture two rings linked so that neither can slip free.
abstract.cn: 想象两枚环相扣，谁都脱不开。

examples.en: Read the contract closely before you sign it.
examples.cn: 签字之前仔细读一遍合同。

examples.en: Diet and mood are closely connected.
examples.cn: 饮食与情绪密切相关。

examples.en: The police are watching the port closely.
examples.cn: 警方正在密切监视这个港口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 closely 记成「贴近地」：贴得近，才看得细，也才连得紧。

root: 由形容词 close 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，close 源自拉丁语 claudere（关闭），引申为围合而接近。

sensesIntro.en: The same adverb covers nearness of the eye and nearness of connection.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个副词既指眼睛贴近，也指联系紧密。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something brought so near that no gap remains.
core.cn: 核心意象：某物被拉到极近，几乎不留缝隙。

branches.en: Nearness of the eye becomes care in looking.
branches.cn: 眼睛的贴近变成观看时的细心。

branches.en: Nearness between things becomes a strong link.
branches.cn: 事物之间的贴近变成牢固的联系。

branches.en: Both senses come from the adjective close and its idea of no distance.
branches.cn: 两个义项都来自形容词 close 及其「没有距离」的意思。

branches.en: The word often pairs with linked, related and tied.
branches.cn: 这个词常与 linked、related、tied 搭配。

branches.en: Care and connection are two readings of one small gap.
branches.cn: 细心与联系是同一个小缝隙的两种读法。

intro.en: The adverb is a suffix product, and its family comes from the adjective close.
intro.cn: 这个副词是加后缀的产物，其家族来自形容词 close。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin claudere, to shut, through French clos, enclosed.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 claudere（关闭），经法语 clos（围起来的）而来。

items.example: The station is close to the hotel.
items.exampleCN: 车站离旅馆很近。

items.example: This path is closer than the road.
items.exampleCN: 这条小路比大路更近。

items.example: She chose the closest seat to the door.
items.exampleCN: 她选了离门最近的座位。

items.example: The closeness of the houses surprised him.
items.exampleCN: 房屋之间挨得之近让他吃惊。

items.meaning: in a near or careful way
items.example: The two issues are closely related.
items.exampleCN: 这两个问题密切相关。

items.example: The office is closed on Sunday.
items.exampleCN: 办公室周日不开放。

items.example: The closing date is next Friday.
items.exampleCN: 截止日期是下周五。

items.meaning: the act of shutting something down
items.example: The closure left the town without a bank.
items.exampleCN: 这次关闭让小镇没有了银行。

latinEntries.example: Clausum gave French clos and English close.
latinEntries.exampleCN: clausum 衍生出法语 clos 与英语 close。

definition_zh: 壁橱；小房间；秘密的
definition_en: a cupboard built into a wall for hanging clothes, a small private room, or kept secret
core_image: 墙内那扇不起眼的窄门，门后挂满外套
scene: 卧室墙边有一扇不显眼的窄门，门缝里露出大衣的下摆。The coats are hanging in the closet by the door.
sceneCN: 这里 closet 指「壁橱」（第 1 个义项：嵌在墙里挂衣服的柜子）；句意是外套挂在门边的壁橱里。

derivatives.zh: 闭门不出的；秘而不宣的

senses.title: A built-in cupboard
senses.definition: a cupboard built into the wall of a room, used for hanging clothes
senses.definitionCN: 嵌在房间墙壁里、用来挂衣服的柜子
senses.example: She hung her winter coat in the closet.
senses.exampleCN: 她把冬衣挂进了壁橱。
senses.why: The French word named any small enclosed space, and a cupboard for clothes is exactly that.
senses.whyCN: 法语原词指任何小的围合空间，而挂衣服的柜子正是这种空间。

senses.title: A small private room
senses.definition: a small room used for private talk or study
senses.definitionCN: 用来私下交谈或读书的小房间
senses.example: The two men spoke in a closet behind the library.
senses.exampleCN: 两个人在图书室后面的小房间里谈话。
senses.why: Before it meant a cupboard, the word meant a closed private room for study or prayer.
senses.whyCN: 在指柜子之前，这个词指供读书或祈祷的封闭小室。

senses.title: Kept secret
senses.definition: used before a noun to describe a hidden habit or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 用于名词前，形容隐藏的习惯或情感
senses.example: He is a closet poet who never shows his work.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个从不示人的秘密诗人。
senses.why: Whatever is kept in a closed room stays unseen, so the noun became an adjective for hidden things.
senses.whyCN: 关在小房间里的东西看不见，于是名词变成了形容隐藏之物的形容词。

intro.en: Closet is a small enclosure in French, built on the Latin word for shut.
intro.cn: closet 是法语里的小围合空间，建立在拉丁语表示关闭的词上。

items.en: Clausum described something shut or enclosed.
items.cn: clausum 描述关上的或围合的事物。

items.en: Closet meant a small private room.
items.cn: closet 指私人的小房间。

items.en: English used closet for a private chamber of study or prayer.
items.cn: 英语用 closet 指读书或祈祷的私室。

items.en: The sense of a cupboard for clothes became common.
items.cn: 指挂衣壁橱的含义变得常见。

items.en: The adjective sense of a hidden habit took hold.
items.cn: 表示隐藏习惯的形容词义固定下来。

items.en: Closet now means both the cupboard and the secret.
items.cn: closet 如今既指柜子，也指秘密。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words from the same shut family, while the meaning group names storage furniture.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「关闭」词族的词，近义组列出储物家具。

entries.definition: to shut something or bring it to an end
the act of shutting a place or an activity
entries.definitionCN: 关闭某地或某项活动的行为

entries.definition: a covered walk in a monastery or convent
a large piece of furniture for keeping clothes
a piece of furniture with doors and shelves
a cupboard with drawers and shelves

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the small shut room, the clothes rail and the secret kept behind the door.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从关闭的小室、挂衣杆和门后的秘密入手。

normal.en: Closet is close plus -et, a small shut place.
normal.cn: closet 就是 close 加 -et，一个关起来的小地方。

normal.en: A closet is smaller than a room and larger than a box.
normal.cn: closet 比房间小，比盒子大。

normal.en: American homes say closet where British homes may say cupboard.
normal.cn: 美式住宅说 closet，英式住宅可能说 cupboard。

normal.en: Come out of the closet means step out of the closed room.
normal.cn: come out of the closet 就是走出那间关着的屋子。

normal.en: A closet poet keeps the poems behind the door.
normal.cn: closet poet 把诗藏在门后。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow door in a bedroom wall, a row of coats inside.
abstract.cn: 想象卧室墙上的一扇窄门，里面一排外套。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny study with one chair and one candle.
abstract.cn: 想象一间只有一把椅子和一支蜡烛的小书房。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook hidden on the top shelf, out of sight.
abstract.cn: 想象顶层搁板上藏着一本看不见的笔记本。

examples.en: She hung the dress in the closet and shut the door.
examples.cn: 她把裙子挂进壁橱，关上了门。

examples.en: The old house has a narrow closet under the stairs.
examples.cn: 这座老房子在楼梯下有一个窄小的储物间。

examples.en: He is a closet cook who never invites anyone to dinner.
examples.cn: 他做得一手好菜，却从不请人吃饭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 closet 记成「关起来的小格子」：门一合，衣服和秘密都收在里面。

root: 源自古法语 closet（小围合空间），出自拉丁语 clausum（关上的），与 close 同源。

sensesIntro.en: From a small shut room to a cupboard for clothes, then to anything kept hidden.
sensesIntro.cn: 从关闭的小室，到挂衣服的柜子，再到任何隐藏起来的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow door in a wall, closed on what lies inside.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙上的一扇窄门，把里面的东西关住。

branches.en: The cupboard sense keeps the shape of a small closed space.
branches.cn: 柜子义保留了小型封闭空间的样子。

branches.en: The room sense is the older one, kept for private talk and study.
branches.cn: 房间义更古老，用于私下交谈与读书。

branches.en: What stays behind a closed door becomes a picture of secrecy.
branches.cn: 留在关门之后的东西成了秘密的写照。

branches.en: A private room and a private habit share the same wall.
branches.cn: 私人房间与私人习惯共用同一堵墙。

branches.en: The cupboard hides coats the way the adjective hides a habit.
branches.cn: 柜子藏外套，正如同形容词藏起一种习惯。

intro.en: The stem closet takes compounds and two endings, all pointing back to a closed space.
intro.cn: 词干 closet 接受复合与两个词尾，都指回封闭空间。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin clausum, shut, which became French clos and then closet.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 clausum（关上的），后成法语 clos，再加词尾成 closet。

items.example: The flat has closets in both bedrooms.
items.exampleCN: 这套公寓两间卧室都有壁橱。

items.meaning: kept private or shut away with someone
items.meaningCN: 秘而不宣的；闭门相对的
items.example: The two leaders were closeted for an hour.
items.exampleCN: 两位领导人闭门谈了一个小时。

items.meaning: as much as a closet can hold
items.example: She owns a closetful of scarves.
items.exampleCN: 她有满满一柜子围巾。

items.example: They rented a closet-size office.
items.exampleCN: 他们租了一间壁橱大小的办公室。

items.meaning: the door that closes a cupboard
items.example: The closet door will not shut properly.
items.exampleCN: 壁橱门关不严。

items.meaning: a cupboard large enough to enter
items.example: The main bedroom has a walk-in closet.
items.exampleCN: 主卧有一个可步入式衣帽间。

items.example: Old houses rarely have enough closet space.
items.exampleCN: 老房子很少有足够的储物空间。

items.meaning: an old term for a toilet room
items.example: The sign on the door said water closet.
items.exampleCN: 门上的牌子写着厕所。

latinEntries.exampleCN: clausum 在法语中变成 clos。

definition_zh: 布；布料；（一块）布；神职人员
definition_en: woven material used for making clothes or covering things, a piece of such material, or the clergy as a group
core_image: 缝纫台上摊开的一卷灰蓝布料
scene: 缝纫台上摊着一卷灰蓝布料，剪刀停在一边。She cut a long strip of cloth for the hem.
sceneCN: 这里 cloth 指「布料」（第 1 个义项：织成的材料）；句意是她剪下一条长布做衣服的折边。

pos.zh: 布；布料；（一块）布；神职人员

senses.title: Woven material
senses.definition: material made by weaving cotton, wool or other fibres
senses.definitionCN: 由棉、毛等纤维织成的材料
senses.example: The market sells cloth by the metre.
senses.exampleCN: 这个市场按米卖布。
senses.why: The old word named any woven stuff before it named a finished garment.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的词先指任何织成品，后来才指成衣。

senses.title: A piece of cloth
senses.definition: a piece of woven material used for cleaning or covering
senses.definitionCN: 用来擦拭或覆盖的一块织物
senses.example: He wiped the table with a wet cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 他用湿布擦了桌子。
senses.why: A countable piece cut from the whole became its own everyday object.
senses.whyCN: 从整卷布上剪下的一块成了日常使用的独立物件。

senses.title: The clergy
senses.definition: the group of Christian priests, used in older writing
senses.definitionCN: 基督教教士群体，用于较早的文本
senses.example: Men of the cloth gathered for the service.
senses.exampleCN: 神职人员聚集参加礼拜。
senses.why: Clergy wore a distinctive cloth, so the material came to stand for the people.
senses.whyCN: 教士穿着独特的布料，于是材料代指了这群人。

intro.en: Cloth is an Old English word that once meant both the material and a garment.
intro.cn: cloth 是古英语词，曾经既指材料也指一件衣服。

items.en: Claþ meant cloth and also a garment.
items.cn: claþ 既指布料，也指衣服。

items.en: Related words in German and Dutch named woven stuff.
items.cn: 德语和荷兰语中的相关词指织物。

items.en: Cloth and clothes split into two separate words.
items.cn: cloth 与 clothes 分成两个不同的词。

items.en: The cloth came to stand for the clergy as a group.
items.cn: the cloth 开始代指神职人员群体。

items.en: Cloth now names the material rather than a finished coat.
items.cn: cloth 如今指材料，而不是做好的外套。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the clothing verbs and nouns close in spelling, while the meaning group names woven material.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的穿衣类动词与名词，近义组列出织物材料。

entries.definition: to put clothes on someone
the things people wear on their bodies
a small thick mass formed in a liquid
cloth made by weaving or knitting
any cloth produced by weaving
substance from which things are made

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the single breath at the end of the word and the cloth spread on a sewing table.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从词尾那一口气和缝纫台上摊开的布入手。

normal.en: Cloth ends in a thin th, like thread pulled tight.
normal.cn: cloth 以轻薄的 th 收尾，像绷紧的线。

normal.en: Cloth is the material, clothes are the things made from it.
normal.cn: cloth 是材料，clothes 是用它做成的东西。

normal.en: One cloth, two cloths: the plural keeps the same soft ending.
normal.cn: 一块布写作 cloth，两块布写作 cloths，词尾依旧轻柔。

normal.en: A man of the cloth wears a special garment, and the garment gave him the name.
normal.cn: 神职人员穿特别的衣服，衣服给了他这个称呼。

normal.en: Clothier is the old trader in cloth.
normal.cn: clothier 就是旧时的布商。

abstract.en: Picture a roll of grey-blue cloth opening across a wooden table.
abstract.cn: 想象一卷灰蓝布料在木桌上铺开。

abstract.en: Picture a folded square of cloth beside a bucket of water.
abstract.cn: 想象一块叠好的方布放在水桶旁。

abstract.en: Picture a market stall hung with cloth in many colours.
abstract.cn: 想象一个挂满各色布匹的集市摊位。

examples.en: Wool cloth holds warmth even when it is damp.
examples.cn: 毛料即使受潮也能保暖。

examples.en: She spread a clean cloth over the table.
examples.cn: 她在桌上铺了一块干净的布。

examples.en: The tailor measured the cloth before cutting it.
examples.cn: 裁缝先量好布料再下剪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cloth 记成「织出来的东西」：线交叉成面，还没做成衣服，就叫布。

root: 源自古英语 claþ（布；衣服），属日耳曼语族，本义是织成的材料，后与 clothes 分工。

sensesIntro.en: From woven material to a single piece for wiping, and then to the people who wear a special garment.
sensesIntro.cn: 从织物材料，到一块用来擦拭的布，再到穿着特别衣袍的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: threads crossing each other into a flat sheet.
core.cn: 核心意象：纱线纵横交错成一张平面。

branches.en: The material sense is the base of the whole family.
branches.cn: 材料义是整个词族的基础。

branches.en: A piece cut from the roll becomes a countable tool for cleaning.
branches.cn: 从整卷剪下的一块成了可数的清洁工具。

branches.en: A special garment came to stand for the people who wear it.
branches.cn: 特别的衣袍代指了穿它的人。

branches.en: Material and piece differ only in being cut to size.
branches.cn: 材料与一块布的区别只在于是否裁好尺寸。

branches.en: The fabric and the clergy are linked through what is worn.
branches.cn: 布料与神职人员通过穿着之物联系起来。

intro.en: The old noun feeds compounds and a few endings, all about woven material or clothing.
intro.cn: 这个古老名词衍生出复合词与少量词尾，都与织物或衣物有关。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base here; the root is the Old English noun claþ.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语名词 claþ。

items.meaning: more than one piece of woven material
items.example: Stack the clean cloths on the shelf.
items.exampleCN: 把干净的布叠放在架子上。

items.meaning: a trader or maker of clothes
items.example: The clothier sold wool and linen.
items.exampleCN: 这位布商卖羊毛与亚麻。

items.example: Warm clothing is needed in winter.
items.exampleCN: 冬天需要保暖的衣物。

items.example: The paper has a soft clothlike surface.
items.exampleCN: 这种纸表面像布一样柔软。

items.meaning: bound in cloth rather than paper
items.example: She collects clothbound novels.
items.exampleCN: 她收藏布面精装小说。

items.meaning: a cloth spread over a table
items.example: The tablecloth is white with blue stripes.
items.exampleCN: 桌布是白底蓝条纹的。

items.example: Rinse the dishcloth after use.
items.exampleCN: 用完后把洗碗布冲净。

items.meaning: a soft flat cap made of cloth
items.example: He wore a grey cloth cap.
items.exampleCN: 他戴着一顶灰色布帽。

definition_zh: 衣服；服装
definition_en: the things that people wear on their bodies
core_image: 床上敞开的行李箱里叠着几件衣服
scene: 行李箱敞在床上，里面叠着几件换洗衣物。He packed a change of clothes for the trip.
sceneCN: 这里 clothes 指「衣服」（第 1 个义项：身上穿的衣物）；句意是他为这次旅行收拾了一套换洗衣服。

senses.title: Garments in general
senses.definition: the garments that a person wears, taken as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 一个人身上所穿衣物的总称
senses.example: His clothes were wet from the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 他的衣服被雨淋湿了。
senses.why: The word is an old plural of cloth, so it names many pieces of cloth used as garments.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 cloth 的古老复数形式，指用来做衣服的许多块布。

senses.title: Garments for a purpose
senses.definition: the kind of garments worn for a stated activity or occasion
senses.definitionCN: 为某种活动或场合所穿的服装
senses.example: Bring warm clothes for the mountain walk.
senses.exampleCN: 爬山要带上保暖的衣物。
senses.why: Adding a purpose word narrows the general mass to one usable set.
senses.whyCN: 加上表示用途的词，就把笼统的一堆衣缩成一套可用的服装。

intro.en: Clothes began as the simple plural of cloth, and it still keeps that shape.
intro.cn: clothes 最初只是 cloth 的普通复数，至今仍保留这个形态。

items.en: Claþas was the plural of claþ, a cloth or a garment.
items.cn: claþas 是 claþ（布或衣服）的复数。

items.en: The plural became a word in its own right for garments.
items.cn: 这个复数独立成词，专指衣物。

items.en: The spelling clothes appeared beside the older clothes forms.
items.cn: 拼写 clothes 与更早的写法并行出现。

items.en: Clothes settled as the everyday word for what people wear.
items.cn: clothes 固定为指人们所穿之物的日常词。

items.en: The word is now plural only, with no singular in use.
items.cn: 这个词如今只有复数形式，单数已不再使用。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the cloth words that look nearly the same, while the meaning group names what is worn.
note.cn: 形近组收外形几乎相同的 cloth 家族词，近义组列出所穿之物。

entries.definition: to put clothes on someone
woven material used for garments
wearing clothes of a stated kind
clothes considered as a whole category
a single piece of clothing
clothes of a particular formal kind

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the missing singular, the silent e and the packed suitcase.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从缺失的单数、不发音的 e 和装好的行李箱入手。

normal.en: There is no clothe noun here, only cloth and clothes.
normal.cn: 作名词时没有 clothe 这种单数，只有 cloth 与 clothes。

normal.en: The e in clothes is not pronounced, so the word sounds like cloze.
normal.cn: clothes 里的 e 不发音，听起来像 cloze。

normal.en: Clothes is always plural, like trousers and glasses.
normal.cn: clothes 永远是复数，就像 trousers 和 glasses。

normal.en: A change of clothes is the small bag you take for one night.
normal.cn: a change of clothes 就是一晚出行带的小包衣物。

normal.en: Clothing is the shop window word, clothes is the bedroom word.
normal.cn: clothing 是橱窗里的说法，clothes 是卧室里的说法。

abstract.en: Picture a suitcase with three folded shirts on top.
abstract.cn: 想象一只行李箱，上面叠着三件衬衫。

abstract.en: Picture a line of coats on a rail, shoulder to shoulder.
abstract.cn: 想象一排外套在横杆上肩并肩挂着。

abstract.en: Picture wet clothes steaming beside a stove.
abstract.cn: 想象湿衣服在炉边冒着热气。

examples.en: Hang your wet clothes by the fire.
examples.cn: 把湿衣服挂在火边。

examples.en: She bought new clothes for the interview.
examples.cn: 她为面试买了新衣服。

examples.en: Pack light clothes because the island is warm.
examples.cn: 带轻薄的衣服，因为岛上很暖和。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 clothes 记成 cloth 的复数：一块块布拼起来，就成了身上的衣服。

root: 源自古英语 claþas，即 claþ（布；衣服）的复数，后独立成词专指衣物。

sensesIntro.en: One plural form covers all garments, and a purpose word narrows it to one set.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个复数形式涵盖全部衣物，加上用途词便缩小为一套。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: folded garments stacked in an open suitcase.
core.cn: 核心意象：敞开的行李箱里叠着衣物。

branches.en: The general plural names whatever a person wears.
branches.cn: 笼统的复数形式指一个人所穿的任何衣物。

branches.en: A purpose word turns the mass into a selected set.
branches.cn: 用途词把这堆衣物变成选定的一套。

branches.en: Both senses rest on the same old plural of cloth.
branches.cn: 两个义项都建立在 cloth 那个古老复数上。

branches.en: Clothes signals the everyday, personal side of dressing.
branches.cn: clothes 体现穿衣日常而私人的一面。

branches.en: The purpose reading adds weather, work or ceremony.
branches.cn: 用途读法添加天气、工作或礼仪的信息。

intro.en: The plural stem forms compounds for drying and storing, plus the related verbs and nouns.
intro.cn: 这个复数词干构成晾晒与收纳类复合词，并连着相关动词和名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English plural claþas.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语复数 claþas。

items.example: The label lists the clothing materials.
items.exampleCN: 标签列出了衣物的材质。

items.example: They clothe the children every autumn.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年秋天给孩子们添衣。

items.example: The figure was clothed in white.
items.exampleCN: 那个人物身穿白衣。

items.meaning: the material garments are made from
items.example: The cloth is soft and light.
items.exampleCN: 这种布料柔软轻便。

items.meaning: a rope where wet clothes dry
items.example: The clothesline runs across the yard.
items.exampleCN: 晾衣绳横穿过院子。

items.example: Fold the clotheshorse after use.
items.exampleCN: 用完后把晾衣架折起来。

items.example: The clothes shop closes at eight.
items.exampleCN: 服装店八点关门。

items.example: He kept a clothes brush in the drawer.
items.exampleCN: 他在抽屉里放了一把衣刷。
